monster:giant ant.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny, carnivorous ant-like animal with a bite attack and no hands. Those traits support a segmented insect body and visible jaws, but do not specify the sprite's colors or pose.
monster:giant ant.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low, side-view ant with a gray head and body, a red eye, thin dark antennae projecting from the head, dark outlines, and thin legs. The blue-gray patterned ground belongs to the tile background. Tiles 0 and 1 are pixel-identical.
monster:giant ant.modelBrief: Build one compact six-legged ant with a low segmented silhouette, distinct thin antennae, and readable jaws. Keep the antennae separated from the head and backdrop at game size. Use gray surfaces, a red eye, and dark outlines; compare its side view with tile 0. Reuse the model for tile 1.

monster:killer bee.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny flying insect with a poisonous sting. Killer bees are female-only in the game; the two atlas slots do not imply two biological sexes.
monster:killer bee.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a hovering golden-brown bee with pale wings raised above its body, a dark face, thin dangling legs, and a small ground shadow. Tiles 2 and 3 are pixel-identical.
monster:killer bee.modelBrief: Make a compact airborne bee with a segmented golden-brown body, pale upright wings, thin legs, and a readable rear stinger. Keep the sprite's hovering silhouette and reuse one model for both tile slots.

monster:soldier ant.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny, fast insect that bites and delivers a poisonous sting. It is related to the giant ant but has stronger attacks, supporting a more formidable ant design without prescribing a precise color.
monster:soldier ant.visualDescription: PixelHack depicts a low olive-brown ant with a broad rear segment, long angular legs, dark outlines, and a red eye. Tiles 4 and 5 are pixel-identical.
monster:soldier ant.modelBrief: Use a sturdy six-legged ant silhouette with a larger abdomen, prominent biting head, and a small rear stinger. Keep the muted olive-brown palette and red eye; use one model for both tile slots.

monster:fire ant.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny ant-like animal with two bite attacks, one of which deals fire damage. Its fire resistance and fire attack justify a fiery treatment, while the exact red design comes from PixelHack.
monster:fire ant.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a slim, angular ant in deep red and magenta with a brighter red head, red eye, long legs, and a low body. Tiles 6 and 7 are pixel-identical.
monster:fire ant.modelBrief: Make a six-legged red ant with an aggressive low stance, angular limbs, and visible jaws. Use restrained warm highlights to suggest heat while preserving the tile's dark crimson silhouette; share the model across both slots.

monster:giant beetle.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a large carnivorous insect whose attack is a strong bite. Unlike the tiny ants around it in the atlas, this monster should read as bulky and shell-backed.
monster:giant beetle.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat dark indigo beetle with a rounded purple shell, darker head and legs, and a low side-view silhouette. Tiles 8 and 9 are pixel-identical.
monster:giant beetle.modelBrief: Build a broad, low beetle with a domed hard shell, six short sturdy legs, and biting mouthparts. Keep the indigo-purple palette and make it noticeably bulkier than the adjacent ant designs; use one mesh for both slots.

monster:queen bee.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny flying queen bee with a poisonous sting and identifies the species as female. It is a stronger form of killer bee and rules a hive, though the sprite supplies the visual proportions.
monster:queen bee.visualDescription: PixelHack depicts a golden-orange bee with a fuller body than the killer bee, pale wings lifted high, thin hanging legs, and a dark ground shadow. Tiles 10 and 11 are pixel-identical.
monster:queen bee.modelBrief: Reuse the killer bee's wing and limb language, then give the queen a fuller golden body and broader hovering silhouette. Retain a stinger and compare her larger sprite against the killer bee; both queen tile slots can share one model.

monster:acid blob.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny acidic, amorphous blob that can flow under doors. It has no eyes, head, or limbs and no biological sex; its dangerous acid acts when it is struck.
monster:acid blob.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat pale yellow-green puddle or mound with uneven bubbling lobes, darker olive shading, and no clear face or limbs. Tiles 12 and 13 are pixel-identical.
monster:acid blob.modelBrief: Make a low asymmetrical mound of viscous acid with a spreading base and a few raised bubbles. Preserve the pale yellow-green and olive pixel palette; avoid adding eyes, limbs, or a head. Reuse one model for both slots.

monster:quivering blob.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a small, very slow blob that attacks by touch. It is mindless and has no eyes, head, limbs, or biological sex; its quivering identity suggests motion through body deformation.
monster:quivering blob.visualDescription: PixelHack shows an upright layered blob in bright blue and cyan, with a wide dark-blue base, lighter bands, and a small raised tip. Tiles 14 and 15 are pixel-identical.
monster:quivering blob.modelBrief: Sculpt a soft upright mass with stacked, uneven folds and a wide base. Use saturated blue with cyan bands, and convey quivering through shape or animation rather than facial features. One model covers both slots.

monster:gelatinous cube.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a large acidic blob with a cube-like body that engulfs objects and paralyzes by touch. It has no eyes, head, limbs, or biological sex, so any dark marks inside the sprite should remain internal shapes rather than a face.
monster:gelatinous cube.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a chunky green cube with irregular pixel-stepped edges, dark green internal patches, and yellow-green highlights. Tiles 16 and 17 are pixel-identical.
monster:gelatinous cube.modelBrief: Build a translucent or glossy green cube with softened, slightly uneven edges and suspended darker inclusions. Keep the square silhouette clear, avoid a face or limbs, and reuse the model for both atlas slots.

monster:chickatrice.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a small ochre, bird-like creature in profile, with a bright face and chest, dark folded wing, two short legs, and a long curled tail. The male- and female-labeled tiles 18 and 19 are pixel-identical.
monster:chickatrice.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a tiny animal and the weaker young member of the cockatrice family. It can bite and petrify by touch; these are identity cues rather than a reason to add stone texture to the living creature.
monster:chickatrice.modelBrief: Give the chickatrice a compact chick-like body, pointed beak, folded dark wing, short legs, and a prominent curved tail. Keep the warm ochre and brown palette and small scale relative to the cockatrice. One model can serve both identical tiles.

monster:cockatrice.visualDescription: PixelHack depicts a larger reddish-brown bird-reptile in profile, with a bright red comb, curved neck, broad tan-gray wings, dark body, clawed feet, and a long looping tail. Tiles 20 and 21 are pixel-identical.
monster:cockatrice.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a small, egg-laying animal that bites and can turn creatures to stone through touch. Its mythical origin combines a rooster-like head with a serpentine body and wings; the PixelHack tile determines the actual proportions and colors here.
monster:cockatrice.modelBrief: Build a rooster-headed, winged reptile with a curved neck, clawed feet, and a sweeping looped tail. Preserve the low side-view silhouette, reddish-brown body, red comb, and muted wings. Compare size with the smaller chickatrice and reuse one model for both identical tiles.

monster:pyrolisk.visualDescription: PixelHack uses the cockatrice's long-necked, winged silhouette, but colors the head and neck orange and magenta, gives the wings blue-gray edges, and adds a pink accent to the curled tail. Tiles 22 and 23 are pixel-identical.
monster:pyrolisk.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes a small animal related to the cockatrice, distinguished in game by a fiery gaze and bite rather than petrifying touch. Its origin also describes a cockatrice-like body with red accents.
monster:pyrolisk.modelBrief: Reuse the cockatrice's core winged body and curved tail where practical, then make a distinct fire-colored variant with vivid orange-magenta head and neck, blue-gray wing edges, and bright tail accent. Keep the side-view silhouette and one shared model for the identical pair.

monster:jackal.visualDescription: The tile shows a lean tan canine in profile, with upright ears, a cream muzzle and chest, dark paws, and a narrow raised tail.
monster:jackal.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the jackal as a small carnivorous canine with a bite attack and links it to the werejackal's animal form.
monster:jackal.modelBrief: Model a slim four-legged jackal with pointed ears and muzzle, cream ventral fur, and a narrow tail; check its side silhouette against tile 24.

monster:fox.visualDescription: A small golden-orange fox faces left with a pale chest, dark ears and paws, and a full tail curling down behind it.
monster:fox.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a small carnivorous canine that attacks by biting.
monster:fox.modelBrief: Build a small fox with a tapered muzzle, dark pointed ears and feet, and a broad orange tail; keep the pale chest readable from the tile view.

monster:coyote.visualDescription: A long-legged olive-gray canine stands in profile with large ears, a pale lower jaw and underside, and a straight dark-tipped tail.
monster:coyote.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a small carnivorous canine with a bite attack.
monster:coyote.modelBrief: Use a lean coyote body, long legs, pointed ears, and a narrow tail; separate olive-gray back from pale underside.

monster:werejackal.visualDescription: Tiles 30 and 31 show the same rearing tawny jackal form with a dark mane, open muzzle, raised forelegs, and curled tail. Tiles 536 and 537 instead show a mostly bare warm-brown humanoid with a narrow brown canine tail; the human-form heads differ slightly.
monster:werejackal.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a human werecreature that changes between human and jackal forms. The human form can use a weapon, while the animal form bites and can summon nearby jackals or other canines.
monster:werejackal.modelBrief: Make two visibly distinct forms: the upright jackal sprite's elongated head, ruff, forelegs, and tail, plus the lean human-form body with a narrow canine tail. Reuse the animal art for tiles 30 and 31, and preserve the small human-form head differences in tiles 536 and 537.

monster:little dog.visualDescription: The small pup is tan and square-bodied, with a darker face, two short ears, stubby legs, and a tiny raised tail.
monster:little dog.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a small domestic canine that can be tamed and grows into a dog.
monster:little dog.modelBrief: Make a compact puppy with an oversized head, short legs and tail, and warm tan coat; compare its scale with the dog and large dog sprites.

monster:dingo.visualDescription: A lanky ochre wild dog stands in profile with tall pointed ears, a light throat, dark nose, and bushy downturned tail.
monster:dingo.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the dingo as a medium-sized wild canine similar to the domestic dog.
monster:dingo.modelBrief: Model a lean, long-legged dingo with large upright ears, ochre back, cream chest, and a bushy tail; keep it distinct from the smaller domestic dog.

monster:dog.visualDescription: A mid-sized golden-brown dog stands left-facing, with a lifted head, pale muzzle and underside, and a fluffy tail.
monster:dog.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki calls the dog a medium-sized domestic carnivorous canine that can be tamed and may grow into a large dog.
monster:dog.modelBrief: Build the middle stage of the dog family with longer legs and torso than the pup, a golden coat, and lifted fluffy tail.

monster:large dog.visualDescription: A sturdy tall brown dog faces left, with a deep chest, darker back, white muzzle, and thick low tail.
monster:large dog.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the large dog as the strong final domestic dog growth stage.
monster:large dog.modelBrief: Broaden the dog's chest and limbs and deepen the brown coat; keep the long muzzle and substantial tail visible in profile.

monster:wolf.visualDescription: A blue-gray wolf stands alert with sharp ears, a white muzzle and chest, long legs, and a low thick tail.
monster:wolf.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a medium-sized carnivorous canine and notes the default tileset uses tail length to distinguish sexes.
monster:wolf.modelBrief: Shape a rangy wolf with pointed ears, white face and bib, blue-gray fur, and a full low tail; PixelHack's two slots share the same art.

monster:werewolf.visualDescription: Tiles 42 and 43 show the same upright dark slate wolf creature with yellow eyes, white-toothed muzzle, long forelegs, and trailing tail. Tiles 538 and 539 show a warm-brown humanoid with a dark blue-gray wolf tail and slightly different heads.
monster:werewolf.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a human werecreature that shifts between human and wolf forms and is the strongest werecreature. It uses weapons in human form and a bite in wolf form.
monster:werewolf.modelBrief: Build both the hunched dark wolf form with long forelegs and the lean human-form figure with a blue-gray wolf tail. Share the animal form across tiles 42 and 43, while retaining the small head differences between human-form tiles 538 and 539.

monster:winter wolf cub.visualDescription: A low, small blue-gray wolf pup has a white face and chest, pointed ears, short legs, and a dark blue tail.
monster:winter wolf cub.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies it as the juvenile form of the cold-aligned winter wolf.
monster:winter wolf cub.modelBrief: Build a compact cold-weather wolf cub with thick blue-gray fur and white face, chest, and lower legs; retain a short youthful muzzle.

monster:warg.visualDescription: A heavy, dark olive-brown wolf-like beast has raised back fur, a broad muzzle, thick legs, yellow eye, and dark nose.
monster:warg.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a warg as a larger, darker wolf-like carnivorous canine with a bite attack.
monster:warg.modelBrief: Make a stocky, oversized wolf relative with a shaggy raised ridge, broad head, massive paws, and dark olive-brown coat.

monster:winter wolf.visualDescription: A large pale wolf stands broadside with an icy white coat, blue-gray shadows, pointed ears, and a thick downturned tail.
monster:winter wolf.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a large, strong cold-aligned canine and adult form of the winter wolf cub.
monster:winter wolf.modelBrief: Extend the cub's shapes into a tall wolf with thick white fur, blue-gray shading, and a long full tail; preserve the crisp profile.

monster:hell hound pup.visualDescription: A squat black-gray puppy has a red muzzle, throat, paws, and tail tip, plus pointed ears and a low stance.
monster:hell hound pup.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a juvenile hell hound with a fire affinity.
monster:hell hound pup.modelBrief: Build a compact hellhound pup with charcoal fur, red-hot face and extremities, short legs, and pointed ears; keep the fiery accents tied to visible anatomy.

monster:hell hound.visualDescription: A tall muscular charcoal hound carries a red muzzle, chest, paws, and tail tip, with glowing yellow eyes.
monster:hell hound.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a fire-aligned carnivorous canine stronger than its pup.
monster:hell hound.modelBrief: Enlarge the pup design into a powerful four-legged hound with long jaws, strong shoulders, and restrained red heat accents.

monster:Cerberus.visualDescription: The tile shows a large black three-headed hound with red jaws, chest and legs, a twisting tail, and bright eyes; the two paired images differ in a few details.
monster:Cerberus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Cerberus as a deferred vanilla monster with three bite attacks; its source form is a strong canine.
monster:Cerberus.modelBrief: Model one heavy hound body carrying three distinct black heads and red muzzles, with dark tail and fiery red lower body; compare both tile 54 and 55 details.

monster:gas spore.visualDescription: A floating dark-green orb has a luminous mottled yellow-green crown and thin black tendrils dangling beneath it.
monster:gas spore.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a mindless, limbless sphere that explodes when destroyed.
monster:gas spore.modelBrief: Build an uneven gas-filled globe with green rim, glowing yellow patches, and a few hanging tendrils; place it above the ground shadow.

monster:floating eye.visualDescription: A single large blue-green iris fills a pale fleshy eyeball, held in a gray-brown outer ring with small reddish dangling tendrils.
monster:floating eye.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes an intelligent flying eye whose passive gaze can paralyze attackers.
monster:floating eye.modelBrief: Form one oversized eye in a rounded fleshy housing, with a clear iris, dark pupil, and short tendrils; keep it visibly suspended.

monster:freezing sphere.visualDescription: The sprite is a hovering round blue sphere with a bright white-cyan icy center, deep cobalt edge, and a dark shadow below.
monster:freezing sphere.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a cold-affinity sphere whose explosion deals cold damage.
monster:freezing sphere.modelBrief: Make a simple hovering orb with faceted blue ice around a bright frosty center; avoid adding eyes or limbs.

monster:flaming sphere.visualDescription: A round red-orange sphere glows around a hot yellow core and floats over a red-tinted ground shadow.
monster:flaming sphere.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a light-emitting fiery sphere with an explosive fire attack.
monster:flaming sphere.modelBrief: Build a compact fireball with a yellow core, orange mantle, jagged dark-red rim, and clear floating gap.

monster:shocking sphere.visualDescription: A floating violet orb contains a jagged pink-white electric center, surrounded by deep purple pixels.
monster:shocking sphere.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes an electricity-aligned sphere that emits light and explodes with shock damage.
monster:shocking sphere.modelBrief: Shape a spherical purple energy mass with a luminous irregular pink center and sharp lightning-like highlights; keep it limbless.

monster:beholder.visualDescription: A reddish-brown round head floats with one large central eye, a broad toothy mouth, and several curling eye stalks or tentacles.
monster:beholder.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the vanilla beholder as a deferred flying monster in the eye or sphere class.
monster:beholder.modelBrief: Sculpt a floating spherical body with a dominant eye, open toothed jaw, and multiple curled stalks; use red-brown flesh and dark recesses from the tile.

monster:kitten.visualDescription: A tiny cream kitten sits upright with dark ear tips, square face, pale muzzle, and a thin raised tail.
monster:kitten.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the kitten as a small domestic feline and the juvenile form that can grow into a housecat.
monster:kitten.modelBrief: Make a small sitting cat with oversized head, triangular ears, short paws, and a high thin tail; preserve its cream coat.

monster:housecat.visualDescription: A pale gray-white cat sits sideways with dark ear and tail markings, narrow face, and a long tail curled along the floor.
monster:housecat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the housecat as a domestic feline that can be tamed and may grow into a large cat.
monster:housecat.modelBrief: Build a medium domestic cat with a slender seated body, pointed ears, and a long dark-tipped tail; scale above the kitten.

monster:jaguar.visualDescription: A golden spotted big cat prowls left, showing a heavy head, pale jaws, dark rosette-like markings, thick paws, and an upward curved tail.
monster:jaguar.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the jaguar as a large quadrupedal carnivorous feline that attacks with claws and a bite.
monster:jaguar.modelBrief: Build a muscular golden cat with a broad muzzle, strong paws, dark irregular spots, and a hooked tail.

monster:lynx.visualDescription: A blue-gray cat has long pointed ear tufts, pale eyes and muzzle, mottled dark fur, and a relatively short tail.
monster:lynx.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the lynx as a large quadrupedal feline with claw and bite attacks.
monster:lynx.modelBrief: Model a compact wildcat with prominent ear tufts, short tail, gray coat, and dark spot pattern; keep its face distinct from the jaguar.

monster:panther.visualDescription: A nearly black feline stalks low with dark plum shadows, bright green eyes, heavy shoulders, and a raised thick tail.
monster:panther.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a large carnivorous quadrupedal cat with claw and bite attacks.
monster:panther.modelBrief: Make a sleek dark big cat with broad shoulders, green eyes, and raised tail; use subtle plum highlights to reveal its shape.

monster:large cat.visualDescription: A light gray-white domestic cat stands side-on with pointed ears, long legs, and a thick tail lowered behind it.
monster:large cat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the large cat as a strong domestic feline and final growth stage of the kitten line.
monster:large cat.modelBrief: Enlarge the housecat into a longer-legged standing cat with pale fur and pointed ears; retain domestic proportions rather than big-cat bulk.

monster:tiger.visualDescription: An orange cat with dark stripes, broad face, pale chest, big paws, and lifted ringed tail fills the tile.
monster:tiger.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the tiger as a large quadrupedal feline and the strongest of its monster class.
monster:tiger.modelBrief: Model a powerful tiger with orange and cream fur, dark transverse stripes, broad skull, and heavy paws; match the tile's tail arc.

monster:displacer beast.visualDescription: A dark purple-black catlike beast crouches with a broad head, glowing green eyes, and two large arching feelers rising from its back.
monster:displacer beast.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a large feline monster with a displacement ability; the PixelHack sprite supplies the feeler anatomy and dark palette.
monster:displacer beast.modelBrief: Build a heavy dark feline with four legs and paired long back feelers, pale green eyes, and plum highlights; pose the feelers to frame the head.

monster:gremlin.visualDescription: A small olive-green humanoid has huge sideways ears, a pink open mouth, spindly limbs, clawed hands, and an irregular crouch.
monster:gremlin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a small humanoid that can swim and splits into clones when it contacts water.
monster:gremlin.modelBrief: Sculpt a wiry green goblinlike body with oversized ears, thin claws, and pink inner mouth; keep the low mischievous stance.

monster:gargoyle.visualDescription: A squat stone-gray humanoid crouches with thick arms, clawed feet, a horned head, and dark cracks; paired sprites vary subtly in pose.
monster:gargoyle.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a strong, thick-skinned humanoid with two claw attacks and a bite.
monster:gargoyle.modelBrief: Build a heavy gray stone figure with broad shoulders, horns, claws, and chiseled crack accents; compare tiles 86 and 87 for pose differences.

monster:winged gargoyle.visualDescription: A gray stone humanoid crouches beneath two tall dark wings, with a horned face, muscular arms, and clawed feet; paired tiles differ slightly.
monster:winged gargoyle.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a stronger flying gargoyle with thick skin, claws, and a bite.
monster:winged gargoyle.modelBrief: Extend the gargoyle body with two large batlike stone wings, preserving its broad crouch and gray palette; check both tiles 88 and 89.

monster:hobbit.visualDescription: A short humanlike figure wears a green shirt, brown vest and trousers, with dark hair, reddish bare-looking feet, and a small weapon.
monster:hobbit.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the hobbit as a small humanoid, also called a halfling, that can carry weapons.
monster:hobbit.modelBrief: Model a short round-faced adventurer with green upper clothing, brown lower garments, broad feet, and a modest held weapon.

monster:dwarf.visualDescription: A compact bearded humanoid has a blue-gray horned helmet, long pale beard, red-orange clothing, and a curved weapon.
monster:dwarf.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the dwarf monster as a small weapon-using humanoid and basic form among dwarven monsters.
monster:dwarf.modelBrief: Build a stocky dwarf with large helmet, long light beard, red tunic, and visible curved blade; prioritize the head silhouette.

monster:bugbear.visualDescription: A hulking olive-brown humanoid has a shaggy rounded head, long hanging arms, brown legs, and a large blue-gray club or mace.
monster:bugbear.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a strong humanoid that seeks and uses weapons.
monster:bugbear.modelBrief: Sculpt a broad hairy bugbear with oversized shoulders and arms, a low head, and one heavy blue-gray weapon.

monster:dwarf leader.visualDescription: A short bearded warrior wears a blue-gray horned helmet and red tunic, raising an axe beside a gray shield.
monster:dwarf leader.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the dwarf leader as a stronger dwarf and leader among dwarven monsters.
monster:dwarf leader.modelBrief: Use the dwarf base body with a heavier horned helm, full beard, red clothing, and a clearly raised axe and shield.

monster:dwarf ruler.visualDescription: A crowned bearded dwarf wears gold armor over red cloth, holding a large axe and a round shield.
monster:dwarf ruler.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the dwarf ruler as the strongest dwarf and an overlord of dwarf-kind.
monster:dwarf ruler.modelBrief: Build a regal compact dwarf with gold crown and armor, long pale beard, red mantle, axe, and shield; make the crown the immediate rank cue.

monster:mind flayer.visualDescription: A robed figure has a pale yellow bulbous head with dangling face tentacles, a dark robe, and a gold clawed hand.
monster:mind flayer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a humanoid with an octopus-like tentacled head, telepathy, and intelligence-draining tentacle attacks.
monster:mind flayer.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall robed humanoid with a smooth domed head and several thick mouth tentacles; retain the dark robe and gold-lit skin.

monster:master mind flayer.visualDescription: A blue-robed or blue-skinned figure has a long tentacled face, high dark head crest, red eye, and gold staff.
monster:master mind flayer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a stronger mind flayer with weapon and multiple tentacle attacks.
monster:master mind flayer.modelBrief: Build a taller blue variant of the mind flayer with a more elaborate head silhouette, visible face tentacles, and held staff.

monster:manes.visualDescription: A pink, squat fleshy demon has a wide torso, short thick legs, clawed hands, and a tiny dark face.
monster:manes.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies manes as the most basic nonliving minor demon.
monster:manes.modelBrief: Model a low pink demon with broad soft-looking flesh masses, short claws, and small dark facial recesses; keep its ungainly stance.

monster:homunculus.visualDescription: A tiny red-orange humanoid stands on bent legs with a bright yellow head, dark open mouth, and outstretched arms.
monster:homunculus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a tiny flying minor demon that can bite.
monster:homunculus.modelBrief: Build a small impish humanoid with thin limbs, red body, yellow-orange head, and dark mouth; preserve the compact sprite scale.

monster:imp.visualDescription: A little crimson devil stands upright with two thin horns, black wings or back spines, narrow arms, and yellow eyes.
monster:imp.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the imp as a tiny regenerating minor demon with a claw attack.
monster:imp.modelBrief: Sculpt a narrow red demon with horns, pointed extremities, and dark winglike accents; use yellow eyes as the focal points.

monster:lemure.visualDescription: A pink-brown squat demon has a tall pale skull-like face, heavy draped flesh, short arms, and a dark open mouth.
monster:lemure.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a medium-sized regenerating minor demon with a claw attack.
monster:lemure.modelBrief: Make a lumpy low demon with a skull-like pale face, drooping pink flesh, and stubby claws; distinguish it from the smoother manes.

monster:quasit.visualDescription: A small moss-green creature crouches with long upward horns, yellow eyes, large clawed hands, and a tapering tail.
monster:quasit.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a small minor demon that uses poisonous claws.
monster:quasit.modelBrief: Build a wiry green horned demon with exaggerated claws and a thin tail; keep the forward crouch and angular limbs.

monster:tengu.visualDescription: A birdlike upright creature has a blue-violet body, large black swept wings, a long beak, red-brown lower body, and clawed feet.
monster:tengu.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the tengu as a teleporting minor demon with a bite attack; its birdlike form is supplied by the sprite.
monster:tengu.modelBrief: Model a dark winged bird-demon with prominent beak, layered blue-purple feathers, and bird talons; preserve the upright side pose.

monster:blue jelly.visualDescription: A low cobalt-blue dome shows a broad bright cyan-white glossy patch and dark base, with no eyes or limbs.
monster:blue jelly.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes an eyeless amorphous sessile jelly with a passive cold attack.
monster:blue jelly.modelBrief: Make a squat translucent blue jelly mound with a white-cyan highlight and soft uneven edge; leave it faceless.

monster:spotted jelly.visualDescription: A low gray-green jelly dome is marked with red spots, pale sheen, and a dark olive base.
monster:spotted jelly.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies an eyeless amorphous sessile jelly whose passive attack is acidic.
monster:spotted jelly.modelBrief: Build a rounded gray-olive jelly with scattered red inclusions and a pale top sheen; avoid facial features or limbs.

monster:ochre jelly.visualDescription: The tile shows a low ochre-brown mound with a pale glowing yellow spot near its top and an uneven spreading base.
monster:ochre jelly.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a mobile acidic amoeboid jelly that can engulf a target.
monster:ochre jelly.modelBrief: Build a broad flowing ochre mass with an irregular puddle edge and one translucent yellow highlight; do not add limbs or a face.

monster:kobold.visualDescription: A small red-brown reptilian humanoid stands sideways with a long snout, thin tail, bent legs, and short arms.
monster:kobold.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the kobold as the basic weapon-using member of its monster group.
monster:kobold.modelBrief: Model a little biped with narrow lizardlike muzzle, long tail, and reddish-brown skin; leave room for a held weapon.

monster:large kobold.visualDescription: A taller brown reptilian humanoid has a long tail, angular snout, forward reaching arm, and a small raised weapon.
monster:large kobold.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a slightly larger and stronger version of the kobold.
monster:large kobold.modelBrief: Lengthen the kobold's torso, legs, and tail while keeping the same reptilian anatomy and warm brown palette.

monster:kobold leader.visualDescription: A dark red-brown kobold crouches with a pale snout and crest, carrying a gray tridentlike pole weapon.
monster:kobold leader.wikiDescription: The wiki's corresponding article is titled Kobold lord and describes the strongest weapon attack among kobolds; the tile source calls this entry kobold leader.
monster:kobold leader.modelBrief: Give the kobold a stronger stance, pale facial crest, and tall three-pronged weapon; keep the tile label while citing the current wiki title.

monster:kobold shaman.visualDescription: A brown kobold in pale headgear or hair holds a tall staff, with a long tail and hunched profile.
monster:kobold shaman.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the kobold shaman as a spellcasting member of the kobold group.
monster:kobold shaman.modelBrief: Build a small tailed reptilian caster with staff, pale head ornament, and brown robes or body accents; make its staff the main silhouette cue.

monster:leprechaun.visualDescription: A tiny green-hatted humanoid has a bright green face, red beard and vest, pale sleeves, and a gold-colored object at its side.
monster:leprechaun.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies leprechauns as small gold-loving humanoids that teleport.
monster:leprechaun.modelBrief: Model a compact figure with green cap and clothing, red beard, pointed features, and a gold purse or object; keep its playful size.

monster:small mimic.visualDescription: A low pale objectlike lump reveals a large red-rimmed black mouth full of square yellow teeth.
monster:small mimic.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a small mimic that hides by disguising itself as an item or dungeon feature.
monster:small mimic.modelBrief: Build a squat pale creature with one oversized horizontal toothy mouth; allow a closed disguised pose without inventing a fixed object shell.

monster:large mimic.visualDescription: A tall ivory multi-limbed mass has a dark red toothy mouth and several curling arms or tentacles.
monster:large mimic.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a larger sticky mimic that can hide as an item or feature.
monster:large mimic.modelBrief: Sculpt a pale irregular body with curling appendages and a large inset toothy mouth; preserve the creature form shown in tile 134.

monster:giant mimic.visualDescription: A huge pale-beige rounded mass fills the tile, with a wide red mouth, square teeth, and thick curled limbs.
monster:giant mimic.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the giant mimic as the strongest mimic, which also disguises itself and traps by sticking.
monster:giant mimic.modelBrief: Scale the mimic body up into a heavy asymmetrical pale mass with broad mouth and thick limbs; give it a distinct closed disguise state later.

monster:wood nymph.visualDescription: A slender female figure has long brown hair, olive-brown dress or barklike body, pale face, and one arm extended.
monster:wood nymph.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes wood nymphs as humanoid women that teleport and steal items.
monster:wood nymph.modelBrief: Model a slim woodland woman with flowing brown hair, twiglike or draped brown clothing, and an outstretched arm; keep the natural olive palette.

monster:water nymph.visualDescription: A pale blue-green woman has long dark-blue flowing hair, cyan skin or dress, and a green lower garment that resembles water.
monster:water nymph.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a humanoid nymph that teleports and can take the hero's possessions.
monster:water nymph.modelBrief: Sculpt a slender female form with sweeping blue hair and layered aqua-green garment; use flowing shapes to echo the sprite's motion.

monster:mountain nymph.visualDescription: A light-haired female figure wears a blue-gray cap or hood and brown dress, with pale limbs and an upright stance.
monster:mountain nymph.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the mountain nymph as a humanoid woman with the same teleporting and theft behavior as other nymphs.
monster:mountain nymph.modelBrief: Build an upright nymph with pale blue hair or hood, brown draped clothing, and exposed pale arms and legs; retain a distinct mountain-earth palette.

monster:goblin.visualDescription: A small green-faced humanoid has a gray helmet, red mouth, ragged brown clothing, and a small dark weapon.
monster:goblin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the goblin as a small basic orc-type humanoid that uses weapons.
monster:goblin.modelBrief: Build a short green goblin with oversized helmet, thin limbs, ragged brown clothing, and a compact weapon.

monster:hobgoblin.visualDescription: A taller red-brown humanoid has a square gray helmet, dark face, raised weapon, and long legs.
monster:hobgoblin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the hobgoblin as a strong orc-type monster tougher than a goblin.
monster:hobgoblin.modelBrief: Enlarge the goblin silhouette into a leaner, taller soldier with red-brown skin, gray helm, and clearly raised weapon.

monster:orc.visualDescription: A green-gray armored humanoid shows a long jaw, dark helmet, broad shoulder, and a curved gray blade.
monster:orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the orc monster as the base orc counterpart for playable orcs.
monster:orc.modelBrief: Build a lean armored orc with green face, dark metal helm, brown clothing, and curved blade; preserve its forward stride.

monster:hill orc.visualDescription: A tall olive-skinned soldier wears a gray helmet and blue-gray upper armor, with a brown lower garment and raised blade.
monster:hill orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a strong orc that seeks gold, gems, and other equipment.
monster:hill orc.modelBrief: Use an armored orc body with olive skin, gray helm, blue-gray shoulder armor, and one lifted sword.

monster:Mordor orc.visualDescription: A dark olive warrior has a gray-blue helmet, brown clothing, long limbs, and a curved dark weapon.
monster:Mordor orc.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Mordor orc as a slightly stronger but slower orc form.
monster:Mordor orc.modelBrief: Make a darker, heavier armored orc with helmet, long crooked blade, and brown lower clothing; separate it from the hill orc by tone and posture.

monster:Uruk-hai.visualDescription: A dark red-brown orc wears a gray helmet and broad blue-gray shield while holding a curved blade.
monster:Uruk-hai.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Uruk-hai as strong orcs, faster than Mordor orcs.
monster:Uruk-hai.modelBrief: Build a robust shield-bearing orc with gray helm, dark reddish body, and curved sword; make the shield prominent.

monster:orc shaman.visualDescription: A pale olive orc in earth-toned robes raises a staff topped with a gray ornament, with bright eyes and a small headpiece.
monster:orc shaman.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the orc shaman as an orc that casts monster spells.
monster:orc shaman.modelBrief: Model a lean robe-clad orc holding a tall ritual staff, pale olive skin, and distinct headpiece; keep the magical role readable.

monster:orc-captain.visualDescription: A broad dark armored orc has a blue-gray face or mask, a round shield, layered armor, and a raised forked blade.
monster:orc-captain.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the orc-captain as the strongest orc type with two weapon attacks.
monster:orc-captain.modelBrief: Make a heavily armored commander with dark cloak, round shield, imposing helmet or mask, and large weapon.

monster:rock piercer.visualDescription: A brown horizontal stalactite-like shell points forward above a pink fleshy mouth and dark rear body.
monster:rock piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki groups rock piercers with ceiling-hiding carnivorous piercers that drop onto passersby; their shell resembles a stalactite.
monster:rock piercer.modelBrief: Shape an earthy stone cone or pointed shell around a fleshy pink mouth; allow a ceiling-clinging pose and keep the mouth exposed.

monster:iron piercer.visualDescription: A steel-gray pointed shell projects ahead of a dark body, with a pink fleshy opening at the rear.
monster:iron piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the iron piercer as one of three ceiling-hiding piercers with a biting body and stalactite-like shell.
monster:iron piercer.modelBrief: Reuse the piercer body plan with a hard gray metallic tapered shell, dark underside, and visible pink mouth.

monster:glass piercer.visualDescription: A white-cyan crystalline pointed shell has blue facets, red accents, and a pink mouth beneath it.
monster:glass piercer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the glass piercer as a ceiling-hiding member of the piercer group.
monster:glass piercer.modelBrief: Build a clear angular glasslike cone over the fleshy piercer mouth, using icy blue facets and a few red details from the tile.

monster:rothe.visualDescription: A shaggy red-brown quadruped has a broad bull-like head, green eyes, thick legs, and a raised ridged back.
monster:rothe.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the rothe as a large omnivorous quadruped with claw and bite attacks.
monster:rothe.modelBrief: Sculpt a bulky, low beast with heavy forequarters, rough rust-brown fur ridges, broad muzzle, and strong paws.

monster:mumak.visualDescription: A massive blue-gray elephantlike beast faces left with a raised trunk, broad ears, two long ivory tusks, and thick feet.
monster:mumak.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the mumak as a strong, thick-skinned herbivorous elephantlike quadruped.
monster:mumak.modelBrief: Build a bulky elephant body with long trunk, curving ivory tusks, large ears, and columnar legs; preserve the blue-gray palette.

monster:leocrotta.visualDescription: A red-brown beast has a dark wolfish head, long legs, a golden striped torso, and a thin dark tail.
monster:leocrotta.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the leocrotta as a fast omnivorous quadruped with claw and bite attacks.
monster:leocrotta.modelBrief: Model a long-legged hybrid-looking beast with dark narrow head, russet limbs, golden banded back, and slender tail.

monster:wumpus.visualDescription: A large brown animal hunches on four stout legs, with a broad drooping head, pale muzzle, and sloping back.
monster:wumpus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the wumpus as a strong omnivorous quadruped that can cling to ceilings and bites.
monster:wumpus.modelBrief: Sculpt a heavy brown beast with wide muzzle, sloped shoulders, short thick legs, and a dense smooth coat.

monster:titanothere.visualDescription: A pale blue-gray rhinolike creature has a short horned nose, thick neck, barrel body, and massive dark feet.
monster:titanothere.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the titanothere as a thick-skinned herbivorous rhinolike quadruped.
monster:titanothere.modelBrief: Make a stocky prehistoric rhino with blunt paired nose projection, deep barrel torso, blue-gray hide, and massive legs.

monster:baluchitherium.visualDescription: A tall blue-gray prehistoric beast has a small long-faced head, high shoulders, long neck, and heavy legs.
monster:baluchitherium.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baluchitherium as a large thick-skinned herbivorous quadruped.
monster:baluchitherium.modelBrief: Build a very tall rhinolike mammal with an elongated neck and legs, small head, smooth blue-gray hide, and huge feet.

monster:mastodon.visualDescription: A brown woolly elephant fills the tile with a large head, shaggy back, long trunk, and two sweeping white tusks.
monster:mastodon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the mastodon as a huge thick-skinned herbivorous quadruped with headbutt attacks.
monster:mastodon.modelBrief: Model a woolly mastodon with domed shaggy shoulders, thick trunk, long curved tusks, and a heavy four-legged stance.

monster:sewer rat.visualDescription: A tiny blue-gray rat crouches low with small pink ears, pointed nose, thin pink tail, and little dark feet.
monster:sewer rat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the sewer rat as a tiny carnivorous rodent with a bite attack.
monster:sewer rat.modelBrief: Build a low small rat with blue-gray fur, pink ears and tail, pointed muzzle, and narrow paws.

monster:giant rat.visualDescription: A much larger blue-gray rat has bright pink ears, red eyes, thick paws, hunched back, and a long pink tail.
monster:giant rat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the giant rat as a heavier and stronger relative of the sewer rat.
monster:giant rat.modelBrief: Scale up the rat with a fuller torso, pronounced ears and paws, red eyes, and long naked tail.

monster:rabid rat.visualDescription: A large blue-gray rat crouches aggressively with raised back fur, red eyes, bared pale teeth, and a pink tail.
monster:rabid rat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the rabid rat as a dangerous rodent whose bite is poisonous and drains constitution.
monster:rabid rat.modelBrief: Modify the giant rat with spiky fur, lowered attack pose, exposed incisors, and red eyes; keep the same base anatomy.

monster:wererat.visualDescription: Tiles 186 and 187 show the same upright gray rat form with a pointed muzzle, long forelegs, pink paws and tail, and red eyes. Tiles 534 and 535 show a mostly bare warm-brown humanoid with a long pink rat tail and slightly different heads.
monster:wererat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the wererat as a human werecreature that shifts between human and rat forms. The human form can use weapons, while the rat form bites.
monster:wererat.modelBrief: Build two forms: a hunched gray rat creature with pink paws and tail, and a lean warm-brown human-form figure retaining a pink rat tail. Reuse the animal art for tiles 186 and 187, but retain the small head differences in human-form tiles 534 and 535.

monster:rock mole.visualDescription: A squat dark brown burrower has a broad flattened snout, large front digging claws, small eyes, and rocky ridges on its back.
monster:rock mole.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the rock mole as a tunneling metallivorous rodent that can collect gold and gems.
monster:rock mole.modelBrief: Sculpt a low burrowing body with oversized foreclaws, flattened muzzle, brown rocky coat, and short rear legs.

monster:woodchuck.visualDescription: A rounded tawny-brown rodent sits upright with a small face, front paws held close, and a thick flat-looking tail on the ground.
monster:woodchuck.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the woodchuck as a small herbivorous burrowing animal similar to the rock mole in game behavior.
monster:woodchuck.modelBrief: Model a plump upright groundhog with warm brown fur, short paws, rounded ears, and grounded tail; keep it distinct from the low mole.

monster:cave spider.visualDescription: A low brown spider has a rounded amber abdomen, dark head, and eight splayed angular legs.
monster:cave spider.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the cave spider as a tiny egg-laying spider that moves across webs and can hide under items.
monster:cave spider.modelBrief: Build a small low spider with two body segments, bent brown legs, and amber abdomen; retain its compact cave-floor profile.

monster:centipede.visualDescription: A long red-brown segmented arthropod curls across the tile, with many short legs, dark pincers, and an orange central band.
monster:centipede.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the centipede as a tiny carnivorous multi-legged animal in the arachnid group.
monster:centipede.modelBrief: Model a flexible chain of reddish segments with many paired legs and a dark head; keep the curled side silhouette.

monster:giant spider.visualDescription: A broad black-purple spider fills the tile with a heavy abdomen, large downward legs, red eyes, and pale fanglike jaws.
monster:giant spider.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a large spider that resides on webs rather than hiding under items.
monster:giant spider.modelBrief: Build an oversized eight-legged spider with deep plum body, heavy legs, red eyes, and long pale chelicerae.

monster:scorpion.visualDescription: A curled red-brown scorpion has broad front pincers, many legs, and a thick tail arched forward to a pointed stinger.
monster:scorpion.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a small carnivorous scorpion with claw attacks and a poisonous sting.
monster:scorpion.modelBrief: Sculpt paired large claws, segmented reddish body, and a high arched tail ending in a sharp stinger.

monster:lurker above.visualDescription: A dark blue-gray manta-like body floats over a shadow, with wide sweeping lobes, hanging tendrils, and a red mouth beneath.
monster:lurker above.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a flying eyeless, limbless, headless carnivore that engulfs prey from above.
monster:lurker above.modelBrief: Build a suspended flattened mantle with broad lobes, central red underside maw, and curling tendrils; keep eyes absent.

monster:trapper.visualDescription: A dark red ringlike mouth with white teeth appears against gray stone, as if opening from a wall or floor surface.
monster:trapper.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the trapper as a nonflying engulfing predator that hides on the ground.
monster:trapper.modelBrief: Make a low concealed fleshy body whose visible feature is a red tooth-lined opening in the surface; allow an open ambush pose.

monster:pony.visualDescription: A small russet-brown horse stands in profile with short legs, dark mane and tail, and a lighter muzzle.
monster:pony.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the pony as the smallest domestic horse stage, tameable with vegetable food.
monster:pony.modelBrief: Build a compact pony with short legs, chestnut coat, dark mane, and modest tail; keep it shorter than the horse sprite.

monster:white unicorn.visualDescription: A bright white horse-like creature rears slightly, with a long straight horn, gray mane and tail, and blue eye.
monster:white unicorn.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes white unicorns as the lawful color form of the unicorn monster.
monster:white unicorn.modelBrief: Build a slender white horse with a single long forehead horn, lifted foreleg, gray mane, and pale tail.

monster:gray unicorn.visualDescription: A gray-purple unicorn stands tall with one dark forehead horn, darker mane and tail, and lifted front leg.
monster:gray unicorn.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies gray unicorns as the neutral color form of the unicorn.
monster:gray unicorn.modelBrief: Reuse the unicorn anatomy with gray-violet coat, dark mane, and visible horn; preserve the rearing side pose.

monster:black unicorn.visualDescription: A nearly black unicorn has a long dark horn, russet highlights, dark mane, and raised front leg.
monster:black unicorn.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies black unicorns as the chaotic color form of the unicorn.
monster:black unicorn.modelBrief: Use the same horse-and-horn silhouette with near-black coat and restrained reddish edge lighting; keep the horn legible.

monster:horse.visualDescription: A full-sized chestnut horse runs in profile with dark mane, lifted legs, long muzzle, and a trailing dark tail.
monster:horse.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the horse as a strong domestic herbivore that can be tamed and grow into a warhorse.
monster:horse.modelBrief: Model a lean running horse with chestnut coat, dark mane and tail, and longer limbs than the pony.

monster:warhorse.visualDescription: A large muscular brown horse has a high dark mane, heavy chest, powerful legs, and a dark sweeping tail.
monster:warhorse.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the warhorse as the strongest domestic horse stage.
monster:warhorse.modelBrief: Build a broad-chested horse with thick neck and legs, deep brown coat, and flowing dark mane and tail; scale above the regular horse.

monster:fog cloud.visualDescription: A low white and pale-cyan puff with blue outline hovers above a dark ground shadow, with no face or limbs.
monster:fog cloud.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the fog cloud as an amorphous vortex that can pass under doors.
monster:fog cloud.modelBrief: Build a soft irregular white fog mass with blue edge shadows and a low floating gap; keep it faceless.

monster:dust vortex.visualDescription: A rounded brown dust spiral has a darker center, ochre outer ring, and a narrow taper toward the floor.
monster:dust vortex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies a dust vortex that engulfs and blinds targets.
monster:dust vortex.modelBrief: Shape a vertical brown whorl with stacked turning dust bands and a broad rotating top; use no fixed limbs.

monster:ice vortex.visualDescription: A bright cyan-blue spiral has white icy bands around a dark blue center and a pointed lower tip.
monster:ice vortex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a cold-aligned vortex that engulfs and damages with cold.
monster:ice vortex.modelBrief: Build a rotating ice funnel with luminous cyan and white bands over deeper blue core, tapering toward the ground.

monster:energy vortex.visualDescription: A deep purple spiral contains bright pink-violet arcs, a dark inner gap, and a narrow lower cone.
monster:energy vortex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies an electricity-aligned vortex with a shocking engulfing attack.
monster:energy vortex.modelBrief: Model a purple energy funnel with magenta electric arcs and a hollow spinning center; preserve the tapered silhouette.

monster:steam vortex.visualDescription: A gray-white ring of billowing vapor surrounds a dark center, with layered puffs and a small lower taper.
monster:steam vortex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the steam vortex as a fire-affinity vortex that engulfs targets.
monster:steam vortex.modelBrief: Build a pale steam funnel with soft gray ringed clouds, a hollow core, and rising vapor curls.

monster:fire vortex.visualDescription: A bright red-orange spinning mass has a hot yellow curling band and a tapering lower tip.
monster:fire vortex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the fire vortex as the strongest vortex, with a fiery engulfing attack.
monster:fire vortex.modelBrief: Create a spinning flame funnel with red outer shell, orange middle, yellow-hot arc, and narrow base.

monster:baby long worm.visualDescription: A short golden segmented worm rests on the floor, lifting a red circular mouth from its front.
monster:baby long worm.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby long worm as the juvenile stage of the multi-segment long worm, with a bite attack.
monster:baby long worm.modelBrief: Build a short flexible yellow-brown segmented body with raised head and round red mouth; leave it limbless.

monster:baby purple worm.visualDescription: A compact purple segmented worm lies low with a red circular mouth at one lifted end.
monster:baby purple worm.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a juvenile purple worm as a carnivorous slithering worm with a bite attack.
monster:baby purple worm.modelBrief: Model a short thick purple worm with a curled body and tooth-lined red mouth; make it smaller than the adult.

monster:long worm.visualDescription: A huge orange-brown worm is seen almost head-on, its circular red mouth surrounding rows of dark teeth.
monster:long worm.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki notes that the long worm's head and body can occupy several map squares at once.
monster:long worm.modelBrief: Build a long segmented worm body with a prominent round tooth-lined maw; design the body to extend across multiple tile positions.

monster:purple worm.visualDescription: A thick violet worm coils beneath a large red-pink circular mouth with white teeth and dark throat.
monster:purple worm.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the purple worm as a giant limbless carnivore with bite and engulfing attacks.
monster:purple worm.modelBrief: Sculpt a massive coiled purple tube with an oversized round toothed maw and dark throat; emphasize engulfing scale.

monster:grid bug.visualDescription: A small teal-green insect has a faceted bright back, dark body, red thin legs, and short feelers.
monster:grid bug.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the grid bug as an insectlike monster that cannot move or attack diagonally.
monster:grid bug.modelBrief: Build a compact angular bug with bright turquoise carapace, dark underside, and thin red legs; keep its small scale.

monster:xan.visualDescription: A flying insectlike beast has pale gray wings swept upward, teal face, dark red-brown body, and several long legs.
monster:xan.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the xan as a flying mythical insect whose sting wounds the target's legs.
monster:xan.modelBrief: Model a lean airborne insect with long pointed wings, teal head, reddish segmented body, thin legs, and a clear stinger.

monster:yellow light.visualDescription: A small bright white-yellow star radiates orange rays above a dotted yellow glow on the floor.
monster:yellow light.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes an amorphous flying light that illuminates nearby squares and can explode.
monster:yellow light.modelBrief: Build a suspended luminous starburst with a white core, yellow rim, orange rays, and projected warm floor glow; give it no body.

monster:black light.visualDescription: A dark purple star-shaped point hovers above a violet-speckled shadow, with no visible body or face.
monster:black light.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the black light as an amorphous flying light that can pass under doors.
monster:black light.modelBrief: Make a small four-point violet-black glow with sparse purple particles beneath it; keep the light entity abstract.

monster:zruty.visualDescription: A hulking brown hairy biped leans forward with long arms, heavy claws, a wide red mouth, and small pale teeth.
monster:zruty.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the zruty as a large strong carnivorous humanoid animal with claws and a bite.
monster:zruty.modelBrief: Sculpt a heavy ape-like monster with hunched back, shaggy brown fur, dangling arms, claws, and a toothy red maw.

monster:couatl.visualDescription: A teal serpentine creature coils in the air with red-magenta winglike plumes, a small angular head, and long curling tail.
monster:couatl.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a flying serpentine angelic being with bites and a constricting hold.
monster:couatl.modelBrief: Model a feathered teal serpent with long coiled body, bright magenta-red wings or plumes, and a pointed head; preserve its airborne knotlike silhouette.

monster:Aleax.visualDescription: A tan humanoid hovers upright within cyan-blue angular light, with a dark head and orange robe or body.
monster:Aleax.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Aleax as a humanoid angelic being with weapon and kick attacks.
monster:Aleax.modelBrief: Build a slim floating humanoid with warm tan-orange clothing and dark head, framed by sharp cyan aura shapes; do not add unsupported wings.

monster:Angel.visualDescription: A pale winged humanoid hovers with broad white-gray feathered wings, warm face, long white robe, and a blue-gray sword.
monster:Angel.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Angels as strong flying humanoid beings that can wield weapons and cast magic.
monster:Angel.modelBrief: Sculpt a robed winged figure with spread pale feathered wings, warm skin, and a long blue-gray sword; retain the hovering pose.

monster:ki-rin.visualDescription: A richly colored horned quadruped floats with a dark red-brown body, teal and gold decorations, long neck, and curling tail.
monster:ki-rin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the ki-rin as a flying quadrupedal angelic being that uses kicks, a headbutt, and magic.
monster:ki-rin.modelBrief: Build an ornate deer-horse-like quadruped with horned head, flowing tail, and teal-gold accents over burgundy body; pose it aloft.

monster:Archon.visualDescription: A tall golden humanoid hovers with huge tawny wings, bright head and torso, red lower garments, and a commanding upright pose.
monster:Archon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Archons as large powerful flying angelic lords that use weapons, gaze, and spells.
monster:Archon.modelBrief: Make a broad-winged golden armored figure with tall stature, warm red lower cloth, and strong symmetric wing silhouette.

monster:bat.visualDescription: A small brown bat flies toward the viewer with pointed ears, dark red body, and narrow purple-gray wings spread sideways.
monster:bat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a carnivorous flying bat that flits irregularly through the dungeon.
monster:bat.modelBrief: Build a compact bat with membranous spread wings, tiny ears, and reddish-brown body; keep it suspended over its ground shadow.

monster:giant bat.visualDescription: A much larger dark brown bat flies frontally with a broad body, pale claws, large ears, and wide gray-brown wing membranes.
monster:giant bat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the giant bat as a larger and stronger flying bat.
monster:giant bat.modelBrief: Scale up the bat with thicker torso, broader wings, pronounced ears, and visible pale claws.

monster:raven.visualDescription: A black bird flies with wings raised in a high V, a long beak, red eye, and trailing legs.
monster:raven.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a flying carnivorous bird whose claw attack can blind.
monster:raven.modelBrief: Model a glossy black raven with large raised feathered wings, pointed beak, and narrow trailing legs; keep the red eye small.

monster:vampire bat.visualDescription: A dark plum bat flies toward the viewer with enormous curved wings, orange ears and face, sharp pale fangs, and red drops beneath it.
monster:vampire bat.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the vampire bat as the strongest bat and a regenerating flying animal.
monster:vampire bat.modelBrief: Sculpt a large dark bat with curled wing edges, orange face and ears, visible fangs, and restrained red drops under its mouth.

monster:plains centaur.visualDescription: A brown horse body supports a tan human torso in a dark cap; the figure holds a curved bow and has a dark tail.
monster:plains centaur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the plains centaur as a horse-bodied humanoid with weapon and kick attacks.
monster:plains centaur.modelBrief: Join a compact brown horse body to an upright archer torso, keeping the bow, dark headgear, and low tail visible.

monster:forest centaur.visualDescription: A dark brown horse body carries a tan archer wearing a green headpiece, with a curved bow and green saddle-like accent.
monster:forest centaur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the forest centaur as the middle-strength centaur form with weapon and kick attacks.
monster:forest centaur.modelBrief: Build a dark horse-human hybrid with green forest accents, upright torso, and bow; preserve the long horse hindquarters.

monster:mountain centaur.visualDescription: A pale gray horse body supports a tan armored human archer with dark head covering, bow, and yellow-brown chest piece.
monster:mountain centaur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the mountain centaur as the strongest centaur form, attacking with weapon and kicks.
monster:mountain centaur.modelBrief: Use a muscular pale horse body, tan humanoid torso, darker headgear, and bow; make it sturdier than the plains centaur.

monster:baby gray dragon.visualDescription: A small crouched slate-gray dragon has tiny pale wings, short neck, light muzzle, horns, and a curled tail.
monster:baby gray dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby gray dragon as a juvenile dragon associated with magic.
monster:baby gray dragon.modelBrief: Build a compact quadrupedal dragon with gray scales, short horns, small folded wings, and curled tail; keep adult features juvenile.

monster:baby gold dragon.visualDescription: A small golden dragon crouches with deep ochre back, bright yellow wing membrane, short horns, and heavy dark claws.
monster:baby gold dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the baby gold dragon as a juvenile dragon introduced in NetHack 5.0.0.
monster:baby gold dragon.modelBrief: Reuse the baby-dragon body with warm gold scales, ochre shadowing, small golden wings, and dark feet.

monster:baby silver dragon.visualDescription: A squat silver and dark-plum dragon has pale metallic wing membranes, a yellow-gold neck accent, and short curled tail.
monster:baby silver dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby silver dragon as the juvenile silver form, before its scales grant reflection.
monster:baby silver dragon.modelBrief: Model a young dragon with silver-white wing panels, plum-dark body shadows, gold neck detail, and stout claws.

monster:baby shimmering dragon.visualDescription: A pale cyan-white dragon has sparkling yellow highlights, swept-back icy blue wings, a gray body, and curled tail.
monster:baby shimmering dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki lists the baby shimmering dragon as a deferred vanilla monster; the PixelHack atlas nevertheless supplies a dedicated sprite.
monster:baby shimmering dragon.modelBrief: Build a juvenile gray dragon with iridescent cyan-white wings and small gold glints; treat this as a tile-based asset even if the monster is deferred.

monster:baby red dragon.visualDescription: A crouched red dragon has dark crimson body, hot pink-red wing, horned head, and curled tail.
monster:baby red dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the baby red dragon as the juvenile fire-associated dragon.
monster:baby red dragon.modelBrief: Use the shared young-dragon anatomy with crimson scales, bright red-pink wing membrane, horns, and thick tail.

monster:baby white dragon.visualDescription: A small icy gray-white dragon has pale peach wing membrane, light cyan body shading, and dark claws.
monster:baby white dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby white dragon as a juvenile cold-associated dragon.
monster:baby white dragon.modelBrief: Build a pale cold dragon with compact body, translucent peach-white wings, blue-gray shadows, and dark feet.

monster:baby orange dragon.visualDescription: A bright red-orange baby dragon crouches with yellow-orange wing edge, deep red body shadows, and a long curled tail.
monster:baby orange dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the baby orange dragon as a juvenile dragon associated with sleep.
monster:baby orange dragon.modelBrief: Model the same young dragon form in saturated orange-red scales with yellow wing trim; keep its color cue separate from the red dragon.

monster:baby black dragon.visualDescription: A dark charcoal dragon has plum wing shadows, pale eye, long snout, and a curled near-black tail.
monster:baby black dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby black dragon as a juvenile dragon associated with disintegration.
monster:baby black dragon.modelBrief: Use the compact horned dragon body with black scales, subtle plum highlights, dark wing membranes, and a pale eye.

monster:baby blue dragon.visualDescription: A deep indigo young dragon has electric-blue wing and back plates, purple shadows, dark claws, and a curled tail.
monster:baby blue dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the baby blue dragon as a juvenile lightning-associated dragon.
monster:baby blue dragon.modelBrief: Build a small stout dragon with dark cobalt scales, bright blue wing surfaces, violet shadows, and visible horns.

monster:baby green dragon.visualDescription: A compact dragon crouches with a dark blue head, green back and flank, small raised wing, and curled tail.
monster:baby green dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile green dragon associated with poison; it bites but has not yet gained the adult breath attack.
monster:baby green dragon.modelBrief: Sculpt a young four-legged dragon with a short neck, small folded wing, and curled tail; keep the blue-black head and vivid green body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:baby yellow dragon.visualDescription: This small crouched dragon has an orange head and neck, bright yellow wing and body, and a dark curled tail base.
monster:baby yellow dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile yellow dragon associated with acid; its young form attacks by biting.
monster:baby yellow dragon.modelBrief: Reuse the juvenile dragon proportions with a broad yellow wing, orange face, and dark belly and tail base. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gray dragon.visualDescription: A tall rearing dragon has a near-black torso, gray-blue wings, long neck, and coiled tail.
monster:gray dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult dragon of magic whose breath is magic missiles and whose body has a bite and two claws.
monster:gray dragon.modelBrief: Build the shared adult rearing dragon with broad angular wings and a curled tail, then apply muted gray-blue wings against a very dark body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gold dragon.visualDescription: A rearing dragon shows bronze-brown limbs and tail, a bright golden wing, and pale cream face highlights.
monster:gold dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a NetHack 5 adult gold dragon associated with light and fire breath.
monster:gold dragon.modelBrief: Keep the adult dragon silhouette, with warm ivory-gold wing and face highlights over a bronze body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:silver dragon.visualDescription: A dark-bodied rearing dragon has pale silver wing surfaces, white rim highlights, and a curled tail.
monster:silver dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult silver dragon whose cold breath and reflective scales distinguish it from other dragons.
monster:silver dragon.modelBrief: Use the common adult dragon shape with cool metallic wing membranes and crisp white glints while retaining the dark torso. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:shimmering dragon.visualDescription: A dark rearing dragon carries bright cyan-blue wings, pale cyan edging, and a curled tail.
monster:shimmering dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki documents the shimmering dragon as a deferred NetHack monster intended to have displacement and a magic missile breath.
monster:shimmering dragon.modelBrief: Model the normal adult dragon anatomy with blue-white iridescent wings and restrained shifting highlights; do not invent a second body offset as solid anatomy. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:red dragon.visualDescription: A rearing dragon combines a dark crimson body, saturated pink-red wings, and a bright red curled tail.
monster:red dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an adult fire dragon with fire breath, a bite, and claws.
monster:red dragon.modelBrief: Give the adult dragon broad scarlet wing membranes and a hot red tail while preserving the black-red central silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:white dragon.visualDescription: A near-black rearing dragon has pale peach-white wings, light gray edging, and a dark coiled tail.
monster:white dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult dragon associated with cold that breathes freezing air.
monster:white dragon.modelBrief: Use the standard adult frame with frosty white wing surfaces and cool dark limbs; avoid turning the warm sprite highlights into open flame. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:orange dragon.visualDescription: A red-brown rearing dragon bears an orange-yellow wing, bright orange tail, and dark chest.
monster:orange dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an adult orange dragon whose breath puts targets to sleep.
monster:orange dragon.modelBrief: Preserve the adult wing and curled tail forms, using orange and amber membranes over a dark reddish body without adding fire effects. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:black dragon.visualDescription: A heavy near-black dragon rears with charcoal wing panels, dark claws, and a thick curled tail.
monster:black dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult black dragon whose breath disintegrates targets.
monster:black dragon.modelBrief: Use the same dragon anatomy with layered charcoal and muted purple-black surfaces; keep highlights subtle so the wing edge remains legible. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:blue dragon.visualDescription: This rearing dragon has cobalt-blue wings and tail over a dark indigo body, with pale cyan on the wing.
monster:blue dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki associates adult blue dragons with lightning breath.
monster:blue dragon.modelBrief: Build the adult silhouette in saturated indigo and electric blue, keeping the cyan areas as wing highlights rather than constant lightning bolts. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:green dragon.visualDescription: A dark rearing dragon has mint-green wings, emerald tail markings, and a near-black neck and chest.
monster:green dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the adult green dragon with poison breath and poison resistance.
monster:green dragon.modelBrief: Use the adult dragon form, mint wing membranes, emerald scales, and a dark central mass; make the tail curl match the tile. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:yellow dragon.visualDescription: The adult yellow dragon rears with a dark body, orange head, bright yellow wing, and thick amber tail curl.
monster:yellow dragon.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an adult yellow dragon whose breath is acidic rather than fiery.
monster:yellow dragon.modelBrief: Use the common adult dragon shape with yellow membranes and orange edging; compare the two subtly different atlas slots. Check both atlas slots for small pixel differences.

monster:stalker.visualDescription: A pale, partly transparent humanoid spirit rises from a wispy base, with long reaching arms and a skull-like face.
monster:stalker.wikiDescription: The wiki calls the stalker an always-invisible elemental with claw attacks; the visible tile is an artist's depiction of that normally unseen creature.
monster:stalker.modelBrief: Make a translucent ghostly upper body and tapering vapor base, with faint facial hollows; treat the visible form as a visualization of invisibility. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:air elemental.visualDescription: A dark gray cloudlike figure rises from a spiral lower body with a hollow face and sweeping arms.
monster:air elemental.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an unsolid, flying air elemental whose whirling body engulfs and batters targets.
monster:air elemental.modelBrief: Sculpt a turbulent vortex with broad wind arms and hollow central face marks, using charcoal and gray-green translucency. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:fire elemental.visualDescription: A red-orange flame figure has a narrow fiery head, wide sweeping arms, and a tapering base.
monster:fire elemental.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an unsolid, flying fire elemental that emits light and attacks with fiery claws.
monster:fire elemental.modelBrief: Build a humanoid flame silhouette from tapered tongues of red and orange, with bright yellow hotspots and no solid flesh. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:earth elemental.visualDescription: A stocky earth figure is assembled from brown stone chunks, green seams, broad arms, and heavy feet.
monster:earth elemental.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a strong, thick-skinned earth elemental able to pass through walls and strike with a claw.
monster:earth elemental.modelBrief: Construct a bulky rock humanoid with blocky forearms, brown slabs, and green mosslike cracks; keep it squat and weighty. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:water elemental.visualDescription: A blue water figure rises from a broad puddle into a cresting head and two curled, splashlike arms.
monster:water elemental.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an unsolid amphibious water elemental that swims and delivers a powerful claw attack.
monster:water elemental.modelBrief: Shape a surging wave-body with curling water arms and a pool base, using cobalt, cyan, and white foam edges. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:lichen.visualDescription: A low spreading lichen patch forms an irregular yellow-green mound with turquoise tips and no face.
monster:lichen.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies lichen as a very slow fungus with a sticky touch that holds an opponent in place.
monster:lichen.modelBrief: Build a ground-hugging mat of soft fronds and lobes, pale lime at the center and cyan-green at the edges; omit eyes and limbs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:brown mold.visualDescription: A rounded brown mold mound has warm amber patches, a darker maroon rim, and no head or limbs.
monster:brown mold.wikiDescription: The wiki says brown mold is sessile and headless, and its passive defense is associated with cold.
monster:brown mold.modelBrief: Create a low domed fungal mat with brown and amber cell-like lobes; avoid an anthropomorphic face or frosty ice crystals. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:yellow mold.visualDescription: A bright yellow mold mound has cream highlights and a black shadowed underside.
monster:yellow mold.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a sessile, limbless mold whose passive effect can stun attackers.
monster:yellow mold.modelBrief: Build a low porous yellow fungal dome with irregular bright patches, and keep the black underside as ground-contact shading. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:green mold.visualDescription: A green mold mound has yellow-green center spots, darker emerald edges, and a flat black base.
monster:green mold.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an acidic, sessile mold without eyes, head, or limbs.
monster:green mold.modelBrief: Make a low mound of irregular green fungal lobes with acid-yellow highlights; no mouth or creature-like torso. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:red mold.visualDescription: A crimson mold mound has orange-yellow spots, darker red edges, and a flat ground shadow.
monster:red mold.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a sessile mold linked to fire through its passive defense.
monster:red mold.modelBrief: Use the same low fungus profile with red tissue and amber hot spots; keep any heat treatment secondary to the visible mound. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:shrieker.visualDescription: A squat mushroom has a dark purple cap, cyan underside, pink circular markings, and a brown stalk.
monster:shrieker.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a fungus that cannot attack but intermittently shrieks and alerts nearby monsters.
monster:shrieker.modelBrief: Build a squat cap-and-stalk fungus with magenta-ringed pores beneath the cyan cap; express its shriek through animation rather than adding a human mouth. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:violet fungus.visualDescription: A deep violet mushroom-like mass has a magenta-spotted dome, dark stem, and several curling purple tentacles.
monster:violet fungus.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies violet fungus as the strongest fungus or mold and describes a sticky touch that restrains prey.
monster:violet fungus.modelBrief: Model a thick dark stalk with a broad violet cap and flexible tendrils, matching the magenta spots and low ground shadow. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome.visualDescription: A small gnome wears a green pointed cap, dark tunic, and brown boots, with a large nose and compact body.
monster:gnome.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the basic gnome as a small humanoid that can use weapons and collect equipment.
