monster:gnome.modelBrief: Make a short broad-nosed figure with a pointed green hat and dark work clothes, leaving hands suitable for carried gear. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome leader.visualDescription: A sturdier gnome wears a yellow-orange pointed cap and a red-orange tunic with brown boots.
monster:gnome leader.wikiDescription: The wiki calls a gnome leader a stronger, lordly form of the standard gnome; male and female names differ in the game.
monster:gnome leader.modelBrief: Use the basic gnome proportions with richer red clothing and a brighter cap, giving the leader a more assured stance. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnomish wizard.visualDescription: A short hooded figure wears a large magenta wizard hat and purple robe with raised sleeves.
monster:gnomish wizard.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the gnomish wizard as a spellcasting gnome with the same infravision as its kin.
monster:gnomish wizard.modelBrief: Build a small robed gnome with a very broad pointed hat, magenta trim, and free hands for spell gestures. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome ruler.visualDescription: A bearded gnome in a blue coat and pale shirt carries a pale blue-tipped staff or spear.
monster:gnome ruler.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the gnome ruler as the strongest gnome and notes king and queen names for the sexes.
monster:gnome ruler.modelBrief: Make a short regal gnome with a substantial pale beard, blue coat, and slim pale-tipped staff; do not impose a visible crown absent from the tile. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:giant.visualDescription: A hulking brown humanoid has a broad exposed chest, long thick arms, small head, and red loincloth.
monster:giant.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ordinary giant as an enormous, strong humanoid capable of handling boulders and clubs.
monster:giant.modelBrief: Sculpt a very wide torso and powerful arms with comparatively small head and short red waist cloth; keep scale imposing. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:stone giant.visualDescription: A huge gray humanoid has a rounded chest, dark limbs, pale stony highlights, and red loincloth.
monster:stone giant.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the stone giant as a giant humanoid with the standard giant strength and weapon use.
monster:stone giant.modelBrief: Use the giant silhouette with rough gray stone-colored skin and pale flecks, retaining the red loincloth and heavy hands. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:hill giant.visualDescription: A broad brown giant has an ochre chest, dark legs, long arms, and a red waist cloth.
monster:hill giant.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a hill giant as a strong giant humanoid that gathers gems and items.
monster:hill giant.modelBrief: Keep the stout giant proportions and bare brown body, with an ochre belly and simple dark-red cloth. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:fire giant.visualDescription: A giant with thick arms glows red and orange across its broad body and wears a dark red loincloth.
monster:fire giant.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the fire giant as a strong giant with fire resistance and fire-themed identity.
monster:fire giant.modelBrief: Use the common giant body with red skin and bright orange planes; avoid a full flame silhouette since the tile reads as flesh. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:frost giant.visualDescription: A thick-limbed giant has dark blue-gray skin, bright cyan highlights, and a maroon waist cloth.
monster:frost giant.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a frost giant as a giant humanoid associated with cold resistance.
monster:frost giant.modelBrief: Model the same broad giant anatomy in cold blue and gray, using cyan patches for icy skin highlights. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ettin.visualDescription: A massive brown giant shows two small heads above a wide chest and a red loincloth.
monster:ettin.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ettin as an animalistic, two-headed giant humanoid.
monster:ettin.modelBrief: Preserve two separate heads and a single massive torso, with long arms and the same earth-brown palette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:storm giant.visualDescription: A giant with ochre highlights and a red waist cloth has the same broad, long-armed form as neighboring giants.
monster:storm giant.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the storm giant as the most powerful of the ordinary giant types.
monster:storm giant.modelBrief: Use the giant proportions with warm brown and gold skin planes; imply storm power through restrained effects, not permanent lightning absent from the crop. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:titan.visualDescription: A very large gold-brown humanoid has a broad chest, heavy arms, dark legs, and pale trim at one shoulder.
monster:titan.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a titan as a strong giant-sized humanoid that flies and can use weapons, armor, and magic.
monster:titan.modelBrief: Build a towering broad-shouldered humanoid with bronze skin and a little pale shoulder detail; convey its supernatural status without replacing the tile's bodily form. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:minotaur.visualDescription: A horned bull head sits on a muscular red-brown humanoid body with broad arms and dark legs.
monster:minotaur.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the minotaur as a powerful horned humanoid animal with claw and butt attacks.
monster:minotaur.modelBrief: Model a bull muzzle, two tall horns, and muscular humanlike torso, keeping the compact brown-red silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:jabberwock.visualDescription: A lanky dragonlike creature has a long curling neck, small toothy head, orange wings, and a coiled tail.
monster:jabberwock.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a flying jabberwock with biting jaws and catching claws, vulnerable to Vorpal Blade.
monster:jabberwock.modelBrief: Build an elongated serpentine body with two wings and prominent jaws, using brown, orange, and dark red from the crop. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:vorpal jabberwock.visualDescription: A similarly lanky dragonlike creature has teal-green body parts, lime wings, curled neck, and visible jaws.
monster:vorpal jabberwock.wikiDescription: The wiki lists the vorpal jabberwock as a deferred monster related to the normal jabberwock, with stronger bites and claws.
monster:vorpal jabberwock.modelBrief: Reuse the jabberwock anatomy with teal body and bright lime wing membranes; keep this a distinct color variant, even though the monster is deferred. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Keystone Kop.visualDescription: A slim uniformed officer wears a tall white-topped helmet, dark blue tunic, tan belt, and boots; one arm is raised.
monster:Keystone Kop.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the Keystone Kop as the basic member of the police-themed Kop class with a weapon attack.
monster:Keystone Kop.modelBrief: Make a small upright comic officer with blue uniform, white helmet panel, belt, and simple baton-ready hands. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Kop Sergeant.visualDescription: A stockier officer wears a tall white-topped helmet, blue uniform, dark cape or coat, and broad belt.
monster:Kop Sergeant.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the Kop Sergeant as a more capable rank of Keystone Kop with a weapon attack.
monster:Kop Sergeant.modelBrief: Keep the police-uniform family but broaden the torso and add darker shoulder clothing and a stronger stance. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Kop Lieutenant.visualDescription: A blue-coated officer has a tall pale helmet, dark shoulder cape, and a broad tan belt.
monster:Kop Lieutenant.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the Kop Lieutenant as an upper rank in the Keystone Kop class.
monster:Kop Lieutenant.modelBrief: Use the same helmet and blue coat language, with higher-rank bulk and dark shoulder panels that match the tile. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Kop Kaptain.visualDescription: The broadest Kop wears a white-topped helmet, blue chest panel, dark outer coat, and gold epaulet-like squares.
monster:Kop Kaptain.wikiDescription: The wiki places the Kop Kaptain at the top of the Keystone Kop class.
monster:Kop Kaptain.modelBrief: Model a commanding broad officer with a tall hat, gold shoulder accents, blue front panel, and dark coat. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:lich.visualDescription: A skull-faced figure in a plain dark brown hooded robe has pale hands and a narrow hanging hem.
monster:lich.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a lich as an undead spellcaster with cold touch and magical attacks.
monster:lich.modelBrief: Build a skeletal face and hands within a simple brown hooded robe; keep the body mostly concealed. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:demilich.visualDescription: A pale skull and hands emerge from a deep navy hooded robe with a broad lower drape.
monster:demilich.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the demilich as a stronger lich with cold touch and more dangerous spellcasting.
monster:demilich.modelBrief: Reuse skeletal proportions under a dark blue robe, making the pale skull stand out against the broad hood. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:master lich.visualDescription: A skull-faced lich wears an olive-brown wide robe with a red collar and pale hanging hands.
monster:master lich.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the master lich as a powerful undead caster that seeks important magical artifacts.
monster:master lich.modelBrief: Give this rank a heavier robe, red collar, and exposed skull, while preserving the squat triangular cloth silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:arch-lich.visualDescription: A crowned skull wears a broad red-purple robe and holds a green-tipped staff.
monster:arch-lich.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the arch-lich as the most powerful lich, with potent magic and artifact-seeking behavior.
monster:arch-lich.modelBrief: Build a skeletal royal caster with gold crown, oversized red and purple robes, and slim staff with green head. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:kobold mummy.visualDescription: A tiny gray-brown mummy has a long snout, pale wrappings, exposed claw hands, and a red eye.
monster:kobold mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies this as the weakest mummy: an embalmed kobold that attacks with a claw.
monster:kobold mummy.modelBrief: Make a small hunched kobold with pointed muzzle and layered dingy bandages, leaving hands and red eye visible. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome mummy.visualDescription: A short bulky mummy wears gray-brown wrapping, a pointed head silhouette, and a dark lower shroud.
monster:gnome mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a mummified gnome with a claw attack.
monster:gnome mummy.modelBrief: Preserve the compact gnome stature beneath uneven linen bands and a pointed head shape. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:orc mummy.visualDescription: A thin long-limbed mummy has a pale rectangular orcish head, red eye, and dark gray wrappings.
monster:orc mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an undead orc mummy that claws and still collects valuables.
monster:orc mummy.modelBrief: Give a lanky orc body a square snout, reaching arms, and sparse gray-brown bandages. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:dwarf mummy.visualDescription: A stocky wrapped figure has a broad pale beardlike lower face, two pointed upper shapes, and heavy feet.
monster:dwarf mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a mummified dwarf with a claw attack and an interest in gold and gems.
monster:dwarf mummy.modelBrief: Model a short wide dwarf mummy with face protrusions and dense beige wrappings; keep the broad stance. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:elf mummy.visualDescription: A tall narrow mummy has a long neck, slim arms, dark banded torso, and a pale face strip.
monster:elf mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an elf mummy as an undead elf, faster than many other mummies.
monster:elf mummy.modelBrief: Use elongated elven proportions with thin limbs and alternating dark and pale wraps. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:human mummy.visualDescription: A human-shaped mummy has a small pale head, visible red eyes, striped wrapping across the chest, and long arms.
monster:human mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a human mummy that behaves as an undead humanoid despite an unusual internal monster-attribute classification.
monster:human mummy.modelBrief: Build a normal human skeleton under beige and brown bandages, with face and reaching hands exposed. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ettin mummy.visualDescription: A huge round-bodied wrapped monster shows two small heads, broad shoulders, dangling arms, and a red loincloth.
monster:ettin mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the ettin mummy as a mummified two-headed ettin with claw attacks.
monster:ettin mummy.modelBrief: Make one enormous bandaged body with two distinct heads and long arms; preserve the heavy rounded silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:giant mummy.visualDescription: A large one-headed mummy has a pale rounded torso, thick arms, dark feet, and red waist cloth.
monster:giant mummy.wikiDescription: The wiki calls the giant mummy the strongest mummy and describes its claw attacks.
monster:giant mummy.modelBrief: Use giant scale and wide heavy limbs under layered pale wraps, keeping a single head and red lower cloth. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:red naga hatchling.visualDescription: A small naga has a brown upright head above a short red coil with a warm peach patch and tipped tail.
monster:red naga hatchling.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile red naga that bites and is associated with fire and poison resistance.
monster:red naga hatchling.modelBrief: Make a child-sized serpent body with a raised head, tight crimson coil, and orange-peach belly; omit adult-scale fire breath. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:black naga hatchling.visualDescription: A small naga has the same raised brown head above a blue-black coil with a pale white belly.
monster:black naga hatchling.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile black naga that bites and has acid and poison resistance.
monster:black naga hatchling.modelBrief: Use the hatchling naga form with dark blue-gray body, pale belly, and compact curled tail. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:golden naga hatchling.visualDescription: A tiny raised naga head sits above a red-gold coil with a bright yellow-orange belly patch.
monster:golden naga hatchling.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile golden naga with a single bite attack.
monster:golden naga hatchling.modelBrief: Build a short coiled hatchling with golden face and warm red-orange body, rather than the long adult silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:guardian naga hatchling.visualDescription: A small naga head rises over a dark coil marked with a vivid lime-green belly patch.
monster:guardian naga hatchling.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a juvenile guardian naga, mechanically similar to the golden hatchling.
monster:guardian naga hatchling.modelBrief: Use the shared young naga anatomy, but give it dark skin and bright yellow-green coil marking. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:red naga.visualDescription: A long-necked naga raises a brown face above a massive red coil with a bright peach belly patch.
monster:red naga.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an adult red naga that bites and breathes fire.
monster:red naga.modelBrief: Build a serpentine body with raised neck, broad crimson loop, pale inner scales, and a narrow face; reserve flame for breath animation. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:black naga.visualDescription: A raised naga has a dark blue-black coiled body, pale gray inner scales, and the same brown face.
monster:black naga.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a black naga that bites and spits acidic venom.
monster:black naga.modelBrief: Reuse the adult naga anatomy with charcoal-blue coils and a pale inner band; keep acidic effects separate from the body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:golden naga.visualDescription: An adult naga has a golden head accent, red-orange coil, and bright yellow belly patch.
monster:golden naga.wikiDescription: The wiki distinguishes the golden naga by its ability to cast monster spells as well as bite.
monster:golden naga.modelBrief: Use the adult coiled serpent form with warm gold head and belly highlights, allowing the raised neck to support spell gestures through motion. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:guardian naga.visualDescription: A brown-faced naga has a dark coil, vivid green patch, and lime-green highlight near the head.
monster:guardian naga.wikiDescription: The wiki calls the guardian naga the strongest naga, with paralyzing bite, poison spit, and a holding attack.
monster:guardian naga.modelBrief: Make a thick protective-looking serpent with dark scales and bright green markings; retain the tile's looped pose. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ogre.visualDescription: A broad orange-brown ogre has a large bare belly, heavy arms, dark shorts, and a small head.
monster:ogre.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an ogre as a large, strong, carnivorous humanoid able to use weapons.
monster:ogre.modelBrief: Sculpt a bulky barrel-bodied humanoid with long arms, wide jaw, and simple dark waist garment. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ogre leader.visualDescription: A larger ogre wears a dark blue front garment over its brown torso, with massive arms and legs.
monster:ogre leader.wikiDescription: The linked wiki page calls this higher rank an ogre lord; the source catalog uses the newer label ogre leader.
monster:ogre leader.modelBrief: Reuse ogre proportions with broader shoulders and a dark blue chest garment, making rank visible through size and clothing. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ogre tyrant.visualDescription: The broadest ogre has a dark top or crown, pale shoulder patches, blue chest garment, and heavy limbs.
monster:ogre tyrant.wikiDescription: The linked wiki page calls this top rank an ogre king; the source catalog uses the newer label ogre tyrant.
monster:ogre tyrant.modelBrief: Give the ogre leader model a more imposing headpiece and pale shoulder accents while preserving its squat build. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gray ooze.visualDescription: A low charcoal-gray ooze stretches into a peaked wave with pale white slick along its upper surface.
monster:gray ooze.wikiDescription: The wiki describes gray ooze as an acidic amorphous creature whose bite can rust metal.
monster:gray ooze.modelBrief: Create a low shapeless gray mass with an advancing raised lobe and glossy pale streak, without fixed eyes or limbs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:brown pudding.visualDescription: A brown pudding forms a flattened round mound with amber patches and dark mottled edges.
monster:brown pudding.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a blind amorphous pudding that can divide after certain blows.
monster:brown pudding.modelBrief: Build a thick soft dome with irregular amber inclusions; animate surface deformation rather than adding a face. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:green slime.visualDescription: A vivid green slime rises in irregular gooey spires from a pooled base with lime highlights.
monster:green slime.wikiDescription: The wiki describes green slime as a pudding-like creature whose touch progressively slimes its victim.
monster:green slime.modelBrief: Sculpt a viscous green mound with several lifted lobes and yellow-green inner glow, keeping the base spread out. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:black pudding.visualDescription: A black pudding is a glossy dark dome with a single white sheen and a wide black ground-contact base.
monster:black pudding.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a mindless, eyeless acidic pudding that can divide when struck by certain metal attacks.
monster:black pudding.modelBrief: Model a broad tar-like mound with one large reflective patch and subtle blue-black texture; leave it faceless. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:quantum mechanic.visualDescription: A humanlike mechanic in blue-violet clothing holds a purple tool or device beside a small red case.
monster:quantum mechanic.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a quantum mechanic as a humanoid monster whose touch can change a target's speed.
monster:quantum mechanic.modelBrief: Make a slim technician with dark blue coat, purple handheld device, and red box; compare the pair's small accessory color changes. Check both atlas slots for small pixel differences.

monster:genetic engineer.visualDescription: A humanlike scientist wears a white lab coat over dark trousers and holds a purple-yellow instrument.
monster:genetic engineer.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the genetic engineer as a humanoid quantum-mechanic relative whose touch can alter a victim's form.
monster:genetic engineer.modelBrief: Build a slim lab-coated figure with dark tie or shirt and a small violet instrument; inspect the sex-paired color changes before sharing materials. Check both atlas slots for small pixel differences.

monster:rust monster.visualDescription: A brown low-slung beast has a rounded shell-like back, a blunt head, many stout feet, and long curved feelers.
monster:rust monster.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the rust monster as a metal-eating creature that rusts equipment with its antennae.
monster:rust monster.modelBrief: Model a squat armored quadruped or multi-legged beast with conspicuous flexible antennae and a rust-brown shell. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:disenchanter.visualDescription: A blue-purple low beast has a broad back, four short legs, and two long orange-tipped antennae.
monster:disenchanter.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the disenchanter as an animal whose touch drains enchantment from equipment.
monster:disenchanter.modelBrief: Make a sturdy violet quadruped with long probing feelers and orange tips; preserve the tile's rounded back. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:garter snake.visualDescription: An olive snake curls into a small loop with a pale yellow belly and raised narrow head.
monster:garter snake.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the garter snake as a small non-poisonous snake that swims and hides beneath objects.
monster:garter snake.modelBrief: Sculpt a small slender coil with olive upper scales and cream underside, keeping the head close to the body. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:snake.visualDescription: A thick orange-brown snake lies in a compact coil with a broad head and pale lower jaw.
monster:snake.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the generic snake as a swimming, egg-laying carnivore that can hide under items.
monster:snake.modelBrief: Make a medium snake with a low heavy coil, rusty-brown scales, and a defined head without a hood. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:water moccasin.visualDescription: A blue-gray snake winds into a loose S shape with pale underside and a small red mouth.
monster:water moccasin.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a water moccasin as a swimming snake similar to the standard snake.
monster:water moccasin.modelBrief: Model a smooth dark blue-gray serpent with a loose ground-level coil and contrasting pale belly. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:python.visualDescription: A bulky olive python wraps into overlapping coils with a thick neck and dark mottling.
monster:python.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the python as a non-poisonous constrictor that can grab and crush prey.
monster:python.modelBrief: Give this serpent much greater girth than the other snakes, with overlapping olive loops and a powerful head. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:pit viper.visualDescription: A blue-green pit viper forms a wide S coil with upright angular head and dark transverse markings.
monster:pit viper.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the pit viper as a venomous snake with two poisonous bites and heat-sensing infravision.
monster:pit viper.modelBrief: Build a coiled viper with triangular head, dense blue-green scales, and dark bands; keep it separate from the cobra's hood. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:cobra.visualDescription: A brown cobra raises its upper body vertically, spreading a broad hood above a flat ground coil.
monster:cobra.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a venomous cobra able to spit blinding venom.
monster:cobra.modelBrief: Make a tall hooded serpent with brown-gold scales and a stable coiled base, leaving the mouth suitable for a venom effect. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:troll.visualDescription: A long-armed troll has gray skin, black ragged hair, green highlights, protruding tusks, and a dark loincloth.
monster:troll.wikiDescription: The wiki describes trolls as clawing, biting humanoids that regenerate and may rise again from their corpses.
monster:troll.modelBrief: Build a lean hunchbacked troll with very long arms, hooked fingers, dark hair, and green-gray skin. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ice troll.visualDescription: A similarly long-armed troll has cold blue skin, cyan streaks, dark hair, and a red waist wrap.
monster:ice troll.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the ice troll as a tougher cold-resistant troll that can regenerate.
monster:ice troll.modelBrief: Reuse the troll anatomy with ice-blue skin and pale cyan planes, preserving the hunched claws and dark hair. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:rock troll.visualDescription: A hunched troll has reddish-brown skin, a dark mane, long arms, tusks, and a red lower garment.
monster:rock troll.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the rock troll as a physically tougher member of the regenerative troll family.
monster:rock troll.modelBrief: Give the troll body rock-brown and crimson surfaces, with heavy hands and a broad chest. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:water troll.visualDescription: A long-armed troll has dark purple-blue skin, cyan patches, a black mane, and a maroon waist cloth.
monster:water troll.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a water troll as a swimming member of the regenerative troll family.
monster:water troll.modelBrief: Use the hunched troll frame with elongated blue-violet limbs and aquatic cyan highlights; keep claws and hair dark. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Olog-hai.visualDescription: An especially dark troll has slate skin, black hair, huge reaching arms, tusks, and a red loincloth.
monster:Olog-hai.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies Olog-hai as the strongest trolls, retaining the family's regeneration.
monster:Olog-hai.modelBrief: Give the troll family a heavier dark silhouette and longer black claws, avoiding invented armor absent from the crop. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:umber hulk.visualDescription: A broad tan-brown insectoid brute has a squat head, red eyes, oversized forearms, and heavy legs.
monster:umber hulk.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the umber hulk as a powerful rock-tunneling carnivore with claws and a confusing gaze.
monster:umber hulk.modelBrief: Build a bulky arthropod-like humanoid with heavy digging claws, red eyes, and tan plated hide. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:vampire.visualDescription: A pale-faced upright vampire wears a simple brown suit or robe with white collar and dark shoes.
monster:vampire.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a flying, regenerating human undead that drains life by biting and can change into bat or fog forms.
monster:vampire.modelBrief: Model a slim pale humanoid in restrained brown clothing, with fangs subtle enough that the white collar remains visible. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:vampire leader.visualDescription: A pale vampire leader wears a deep crimson robe with high red collar and a dark red lower drape.
monster:vampire leader.wikiDescription: The linked wiki page calls this stronger vampire a vampire lord and describes its life-draining bite and shapeshifting.
monster:vampire leader.modelBrief: Use taller, more regal vampire proportions with crimson layers and a sharp high collar; retain pale face and hands. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:vampire mage.visualDescription: A pale-faced vampire mage wears a blue hooded robe, holds a green wand or staff tip, and has a long dark hem.
monster:vampire mage.wikiDescription: The wiki lists vampire mage as a deferred member of the vampire class, whose members are flying, regenerating human undead.
monster:vampire mage.modelBrief: Build a robed vampire spellcaster in indigo and blue with a small green magical focus; preserve the visible pale face. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Vlad the Impaler.visualDescription: Vlad has a pale face, red eyes, a dark red cape, brown-red clothes, and a visible long blade.
monster:Vlad the Impaler.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies Vlad the Impaler as a unique vampire lord and keeper of the Candelabrum of Invocation.
monster:Vlad the Impaler.modelBrief: Make a distinct regal vampire with layered red cloak, straight weapon, pale face, and a compact stern pose. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:barrow wight.visualDescription: A skeletal wight leans forward with long thin legs, bony hands, a pale skull, and ragged brown cloak.
monster:barrow wight.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a barrow wight as a weapon-bearing undead with life-draining attacks and spellcasting.
monster:barrow wight.modelBrief: Build a gaunt walking corpse with exposed skull, long hands, and torn dark-brown cloak rather than a fully floating ghost. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:wraith.visualDescription: A gray ragged wraith hangs above a small shadow, with hollow hood and trailing strips of cloth.
monster:wraith.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the wraith as an unsolid undead that drains life by touch.
monster:wraith.modelBrief: Create a hovering hollow-hood form of torn gray fabric and misty lower wisps, with no solid legs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Nazgul.visualDescription: A black-hooded specter holds a tall pale sword; its face is a featureless dark void.
monster:Nazgul.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies Nazgul as wraithlike undead with life-draining weapons and sleep breath.
monster:Nazgul.modelBrief: Sculpt a floating charcoal robe around an empty hood and long upright sword, keeping the face invisible. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:xorn.visualDescription: A brown xorn has a wide toothed mouth, several branching claw arms, squat legs, and a thick trunk.
monster:xorn.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a wall-phasing metallivore with three claw attacks and a strong bite.
monster:xorn.modelBrief: Build a three-armed, broad-mouthed alien body with branching claws and stout lower limbs; use ochre-brown skin and a magenta mouth. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:monkey.visualDescription: A small pink-brown monkey stands on two legs with long curved tail, raised hands, and an open red mouth.
monster:monkey.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a small ape-like omnivore that can grab items and be tamed with bananas.
monster:monkey.modelBrief: Make a small lively primate with long prehensile-looking tail, pink face and belly, and narrow limbs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ape.visualDescription: A rusty-red ape stands with both long arms raised, broad chest, small head, and dark feet.
monster:ape.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ape as a strong omnivorous primate with two claws and a bite.
monster:ape.modelBrief: Make a muscular tailless ape with wide raised arms and warm red-brown fur, larger and heavier than the monkey. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:owlbear.visualDescription: A large brown beast has owl-like facial tufts, a pale belly, thick arms, and grasping claws.
monster:owlbear.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the owlbear as a large carnivorous creature that seizes prey with its claws.
monster:owlbear.modelBrief: Combine bear mass and forelimbs with a distinct owl face and ear tufts, preserving the cream belly patch. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:yeti.visualDescription: A pale gray-white shaggy humanoid has broad arms, black face, red eyes, and large feet.
monster:yeti.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the yeti as a strong carnivorous apelike creature with claws and a bite.
monster:yeti.modelBrief: Sculpt a bulky white-furred ape with dark face mask, red eye accents, and short heavy legs. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:carnivorous ape.visualDescription: A tall dark ape raises powerful blue-gray arms around a black face with bright red eyes.
monster:carnivorous ape.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the carnivorous ape as a fiercer obligate-carnivore relative of the ape.
monster:carnivorous ape.modelBrief: Use the ape skeleton with slate-dark fur, oversized shoulders, and intense red eyes; keep hands open and claw-ready. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:sasquatch.visualDescription: A reddish-brown shaggy sasquatch has long arms, wide legs, red eyes, and a dark open mouth.
monster:sasquatch.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies sasquatch as the most difficult of its apelike class, able to see invisible.
monster:sasquatch.modelBrief: Build a large upright hairy ape with a broad shoulder line, warm brown fur, and red eyes. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:kobold zombie.visualDescription: A small greenish kobold zombie has a long snout, hunched back, torn body, and reaching hands.
monster:kobold zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki calls the kobold zombie the weakest zombie, an undead version of the small kobold.
monster:kobold zombie.modelBrief: Make a short decayed kobold with protruding muzzle and stiff clawing arms, using olive skin and dark rotten patches. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gnome zombie.visualDescription: A short gnome zombie wears a floppy gray cap and dark blue clothes, with yellow eyes and raised hands.
monster:gnome zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a zombified gnome that claws and can follow the hero between levels.
monster:gnome zombie.modelBrief: Keep short gnome proportions and recognizable cap, with dull skin, vacant eyes, and torn blue garments. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:orc zombie.visualDescription: A thin orc zombie has a pale green square face, yellow eye, red-brown clothes, and long reaching arms.
monster:orc zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an undead orc that appears in groups and attacks with a claw.
monster:orc zombie.modelBrief: Make a lanky rotting orc with angular snout and sparse reddish clothing, retaining the long-armed silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:dwarf zombie.visualDescription: A broad dwarf zombie has a beardlike pale face, pointed head shapes, maroon clothes, and stout feet.
monster:dwarf zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a zombified dwarf with a claw attack.
monster:dwarf zombie.modelBrief: Preserve a stocky dwarf body and pronounced face or beard under torn red-brown clothing and undead coloring. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:elf zombie.visualDescription: A slim elf zombie wears a brown cap, ochre shirt, and dark leggings; its long arms reach sideways.
monster:elf zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki describes an undead elf with a claw attack and the ability to follow the hero across levels.
monster:elf zombie.modelBrief: Use elongated elven limbs and a simple tan tunic, adding sallow skin and ragged edges. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:human zombie.visualDescription: A narrow human zombie has a pale head, yellow eyes, long hanging arms, and torn tan clothing.
monster:human zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a human corpse reanimated as a clawing undead humanoid.
monster:human zombie.modelBrief: Build a gaunt stiff human with exposed pale face and torn beige shirt, keeping the upright stagger. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ettin zombie.visualDescription: An enormous ettin zombie has two pale heads, thick green-brown arms, wide belly, and dark loincloth.
monster:ettin zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a zombified two-headed ettin and one of the strongest ordinary zombies.
monster:ettin zombie.modelBrief: Make a giant rotting two-headed body with thick asymmetric arms, dull olive hide, and heavy stance. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:ghoul.visualDescription: A crouched blue-gray ghoul holds a small pale skull; a dark face peers from a hoodlike head and a ragged cape trails.
monster:ghoul.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ghoul as an undead humanoid whose touch can paralyze.
monster:ghoul.modelBrief: Build a hunched cadaverous figure in blue-black rags, with one pale skull prop and a menacing outstretched hand. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:giant zombie.visualDescription: A huge green-brown giant zombie has a pale swollen belly, thick arms, dark head, and heavy short legs.
monster:giant zombie.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the giant zombie as the strongest standard zombie, attacking with claws.
monster:giant zombie.modelBrief: Model a giant decaying body with broad gut and heavy reaching arms, using olive rot and pale exposed patches. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:skeleton.visualDescription: A thin tan skeleton stands upright with visible skull, ribs, pelvis, and long bony limbs.
monster:skeleton.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a magically animated humanoid skeleton without organic tissue.
monster:skeleton.modelBrief: Build a clean readable bone rig with open rib cage and skull, using tan bone against dark joints. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:straw golem.visualDescription: A rough humanoid of straw-colored bundles raises one twiggy arm; its dark base spreads like loose fibers.
monster:straw golem.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the straw golem as a weak artificial humanoid whose body is made of straw.
monster:straw golem.modelBrief: Assemble a loose scarecrow-shaped body from bundled straw and jutting stems, with no flesh underneath. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:paper golem.visualDescription: A pale gray paper figure has folded angular limbs, torn sheet-like edges, and a flattened base.
monster:paper golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a paper-built golem that attacks with a claw and yields paper on destruction.
monster:paper golem.modelBrief: Build a thin origami-like humanoid from layered pale sheets, preserving the jagged arms and folded head. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:rope golem.visualDescription: A brown rope figure twists around a narrow torso with looping arms and frayed lower strands.
monster:rope golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a rope golem that claws and can hold or choke prey.
monster:rope golem.modelBrief: Construct intertwined rope coils forming a humanoid, with dangling ends and flexible looped arms. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:gold golem.visualDescription: A bright gold humanoid has broad shoulders, a small peaked head, sturdy feet, and shiny cream highlights.
monster:gold golem.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a golem formed of gold, stronger and tougher than the weakest material golems.
monster:gold golem.modelBrief: Model a dense faceted metal body with rounded block limbs and bright reflective gold planes. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:leather golem.visualDescription: A brown leather golem has a narrow head, long arms, thick chest, and stitched-looking angular surfaces.
monster:leather golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a leather-built golem with two claw attacks.
monster:leather golem.modelBrief: Build a humanoid from overlapping dark-tan leather panels and seams, keeping it flexible and hand-shaped. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:wood golem.visualDescription: A tree-trunk humanoid has a log head, branchlike arms, rootlike feet, and dark carved marks on its torso.
monster:wood golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a slow, thick-skinned wood golem vulnerable to axes.
monster:wood golem.modelBrief: Carve a walking trunk with a cut-log crown, branching hands, and knotted root feet, in reddish brown wood. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:flesh golem.visualDescription: A salmon-pink flesh golem has a bulky hunched torso, long arms, exposed red patches, and dark lower legs.
monster:flesh golem.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the flesh golem as assembled from flesh and notable for leaving a corpse.
monster:flesh golem.modelBrief: Make a stitched humanoid of uneven pink and red body sections, with thick shoulders and trailing hands. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:clay golem.visualDescription: A red-brown clay golem has a blocky head, broad bent arms, rounded chest, and thick tapering legs.
monster:clay golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a strong thick-skinned clay golem whose animated body can be destroyed through its magic writing.
monster:clay golem.modelBrief: Sculpt a dense rough-clay figure with hand-molded joints and warm terracotta highlights. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:stone golem.visualDescription: A blue-gray stone golem has squared shoulders, segmented rocky arms, short torso, and wide feet.
monster:stone golem.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a thick-skinned stone golem resistant to petrification.
monster:stone golem.modelBrief: Build a faceted block-stone humanoid with heavy hands and feet, using slate and pale gray planes. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:glass golem.visualDescription: A spindly humanoid is assembled from green-transparent glass shards with pale cyan highlights and pink-tipped joints.
monster:glass golem.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a glass-built golem with claw attacks and acid resistance.
monster:glass golem.modelBrief: Construct a faceted translucent glass body with angular limbs, green edges, cyan core, and a few magenta reflections. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:iron golem.visualDescription: A tall iron humanoid has olive-gray metal plates, a white-gray chest, branching arms, and dark heavy legs.
monster:iron golem.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the iron golem as the strongest golem, able to wield weapons and breathe poison gas.
monster:iron golem.modelBrief: Build a plated iron automaton with thick joints and a bright central chest; leave hands capable of grasping a weapon. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:human.visualDescription: The tile shows a mostly bare pink-tan human figure with short brown hair, slim arms, and a plain stance.
monster:human.wikiDescription: The wiki treats the generic human monster as the base human form used for hero and undead corpse identities.
monster:human.modelBrief: Model a neutral unarmored human with natural proportions and warm skin tones; compare the male and female atlas poses before choosing separate bodies. Check both atlas slots for small pixel differences.

monster:elf.visualDescription: An elf with pale face and blond-brown hair wears a moss-green tunic, dark trousers, and a gray blade at one side.
monster:elf.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the generic elf monster as the base elven form and corpse identity.
monster:elf.modelBrief: Build a slim pointed-ear humanoid with green tunic, tan hair, and a simple sheathed or held gray weapon. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Woodland-elf.visualDescription: A slender Woodland-elf wears a tan shirt and brown trousers, with one arm holding a narrow dark blade.
monster:Woodland-elf.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the Woodland-elf as the least powerful of the normally generated elven warriors, still able to use weapons.
monster:Woodland-elf.modelBrief: Use light forest clothing and slim elven anatomy, with a small straight sword and pointed ears. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Green-elf.visualDescription: A Green-elf wears olive-green armor or tunic and brown trousers, and holds a curved bow-like weapon.
monster:Green-elf.wikiDescription: The wiki describes Green-elves as slightly stronger than Woodland-elves and capable of wielding weapons.
monster:Green-elf.modelBrief: Model a lean forest fighter in olive clothing with a readable bow and long narrow ears. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:Grey-elf.visualDescription: A Grey-elf wears gray-blue upper clothing, dark pants, a pale cap, and carries a straight sword and red shield.
monster:Grey-elf.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies Grey-elves as a stronger ordinary elven type with weapon use and sleep resistance.
monster:Grey-elf.modelBrief: Keep the slim elf frame, gray-blue outfit, small red shield, and upright sword for a clear rank distinction. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:elf-noble.visualDescription: An elf-noble wears a blue-gray cap, brown armor, red trousers, a red shield, and a raised sword.
monster:elf-noble.wikiDescription: The linked wiki article uses the older name elf-lord for this high-ranking elf with two weapon attacks.
monster:elf-noble.modelBrief: Build an elven officer with a brown cuirass, red shield, bright red legs, and raised blade; keep the cap and lean face. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:elven monarch.visualDescription: The elven monarch has a gold crown, pale blue shoulder drape, green armor, red cape panels, and upright sword.
monster:elven monarch.wikiDescription: The linked wiki page uses the older name Elvenking for the strongest elf ruler.
monster:elven monarch.modelBrief: Model a crowned elven ruler with layered green and blue clothing, red cloak, and long vertical sword; preserve the broad regal silhouette. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:doppelganger.visualDescription: A simple blue-gray humanoid has a pale pink face, smooth head, long limbs, and almost featureless clothing.
monster:doppelganger.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the doppelganger as a shape-changing humanoid that imitates other monsters.
monster:doppelganger.modelBrief: Use a deliberately plain, smooth blue-gray base form with minimal features; reserve copied appearances for transformation states. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:shopkeeper.visualDescription: A brown-clothed shopkeeper wears a dark hat and apronlike front panel, with one hand raised in greeting or warning.
monster:shopkeeper.wikiDescription: The wiki describes shopkeepers as human merchants who manage shop goods and transactions.
monster:shopkeeper.modelBrief: Build a compact merchant with brown hat, russet coat, darker apron panel, and approachable raised hand. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:guard.visualDescription: A guard wears a dark cap and gray chest armor, holds a long pale halberd or polearm, and has brown boots.
monster:guard.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies guards as lawful human mercenaries who patrol vaults.
monster:guard.modelBrief: Model a sturdy armored human with dark helmet, gray breastplate, and long pale-bladed polearm, keeping the weapon taller than the figure. The paired atlas slots can share this design.

monster:prisoner.visualDescription: A thin human in torn pale clothing stands barefoot with bare arms and legs, a warm orange head, and a dark waist band.
monster:prisoner.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the prisoner as a strong human monster that can seek weapons and other items.
monster:prisoner.modelBrief: Build a gaunt captive with ragged light tunic, exposed limbs, dark belt, and unarmed slumped stance.

monster:Oracle.visualDescription: A hooded figure sits or stands behind a brown lectern or bowl, with a deep black face opening and bright magenta head covering.
monster:Oracle.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Oracle as the unique human who provides oracular consultations on the Oracle level.
monster:Oracle.modelBrief: Model a robed seated oracle with purple hood, shadowed face, and a broad brown consultation stand; preserve the small orange flames at the sides as optional scene details.

monster:aligned cleric.visualDescription: A red-robed temple cleric bears a large round crimson shield and a tall pale hooked staff, with a dark head covering.
monster:aligned cleric.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes aligned clerics as human servants of the gods who tend dungeon temples.
monster:aligned cleric.modelBrief: Build a human cleric in layered red vestments with round shield and crooked ivory staff; keep the religious silhouette distinct from army soldiers.

monster:high cleric.visualDescription: A tall figure in purple and gold priestly robes holds a long curled staff; a violet mitre or hood frames the face.
monster:high cleric.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies high clerics as senior human minions of a deity, called high priests or priestesses by gender.
monster:high cleric.modelBrief: Model a ceremonial cleric with purple-and-gold robe panels, tall headdress, and ornate staff; increase stature and ornament over the aligned cleric.

monster:soldier.visualDescription: A helmeted human in bright green tunic stands squarely, holding a long spear and wearing brown boots.
monster:soldier.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the soldier as the lowest rank in the Yendorian army of human mercenaries.
monster:soldier.modelBrief: Build a simple green-uniformed infantryman with metal helmet, spear, belt, and brown boots; preserve the straight upright pose.

monster:sergeant.visualDescription: A green-uniformed helmeted officer carries a tall pole weapon and a round blue-gray shield.
monster:sergeant.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the sergeant as a human Yendorian army fighter ranked above the soldier.
monster:sergeant.modelBrief: Upgrade the soldier with a round metal shield, heavier helmet, and longer polearm; keep the green uniform.

monster:nurse.visualDescription: A human in a white cap and long pale robe shows red markings across the chest and arms, with hands held outward.
monster:nurse.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the nurse as a human monster whose special touch can heal under certain conditions.
monster:nurse.modelBrief: Build a white-clad healer with cap, long skirt, and red trim or staining as shown by the tile; make the open-handed pose readable.

monster:lieutenant.visualDescription: A helmeted human officer wears gray upper armor and olive lower clothing, with a broad red shield and raised sword.
monster:lieutenant.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki places lieutenants near the top of the Yendorian army, below captains, with two weapon attacks.
monster:lieutenant.modelBrief: Model an armored officer with steel helmet, red kite shield, sword, and olive uniform; distinguish rank through more armor.

monster:captain.visualDescription: A heavily armored human officer has a tall helmet, pale breastplate, crimson shield and cloak, and upright sword.
monster:captain.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the captain as the highest Yendorian army rank.
monster:captain.modelBrief: Build a commanding soldier with bright armor, large red shield, sword, and red cape; keep the formal frontal pose.

monster:watchman.visualDescription: A town guard wears a gray helmet and ochre uniform, with a long dark spear and round gray shield.
monster:watchman.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes watchmen and watch captains as the peacekeeping Minetown watch.
monster:watchman.modelBrief: Model a practical town guard with muted yellow-brown clothes, helmet, spear, and round shield; keep it distinct from green army soldiers.

monster:watch captain.visualDescription: A sturdier town guard wears a steel helmet and brown-gold coat, carrying a long pole weapon across the body.
monster:watch captain.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki groups the watch captain with Minetown watchmen as a higher-ranking peacekeeper.
monster:watch captain.modelBrief: Build a broader, better-equipped watch guard with brown-gold coat, dark shoulder armor, helmet, and long weapon.

monster:Medusa.visualDescription: A green-skinned woman has living brown snake hair, red eyes, a gray draped skirt, and a long curved blade.
monster:Medusa.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Medusa as a unique humanoid with a petrifying gaze and snake-haired mythic identity.
monster:Medusa.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall green woman with individual snake locks, red eyes, gray drapery, and raised curved sword; keep her stoning gaze visually central.

monster:Wizard of Yendor.visualDescription: A bearded sorcerer in dark red robes and a pointed magenta cap holds a staff topped by green light.
monster:Wizard of Yendor.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Wizard of Yendor as the unique sorcerer who guards the Book of the Dead and pursues the hero.
monster:Wizard of Yendor.modelBrief: Build a gaunt robed wizard with long dark beard, red-magenta hood, staff, and small green magical glow.

monster:Croesus.visualDescription: A richly dressed human wears a red cloak over gold and purple garments, with a small crown or cap and broad belt.
monster:Croesus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Croesus as the wealthy owner of Fort Ludios and the dungeon vaults.
monster:Croesus.modelBrief: Sculpt a prosperous ruler in layered red cape, gold trim, and purple tunic; emphasize fabric volume and wealth rather than combat armor.

monster:Charon.visualDescription: A skeletal or shadow-faced boatman wears a long dark brown robe and hood, leaning on a wooden staff.
monster:Charon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki notes Charon is an unimplemented peaceful human associated with ferrying across the mythic river.
monster:Charon.modelBrief: Build the tile's hooded ferryman with mostly hidden face, ragged brown robes, and a long pole; keep the unused status documented.

monster:ghost.visualDescription: A pale blue translucent humanoid floats with a dark face, trailing wisps, and bright cyan edge light.
monster:ghost.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes ghosts as undead, noncorporeal humanoids that fly and phase through walls.
monster:ghost.modelBrief: Model a hovering translucent human shape with fading lower wisps, hollow dark face, and cool cyan rim.

monster:shade.visualDescription: An almost black humanoid silhouette rises from a powdery gray base, with long arms and a faint dark head.
monster:shade.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes shades as undead phasing ghosts that can paralyze and slow targets.
monster:shade.modelBrief: Build a sparse dark spectral silhouette with diffuse dissolving lower body and little surface detail; keep it distinct from the luminous ghost.

monster:water demon.visualDescription: A blue-violet aquatic humanoid has an elongated head, thin limbs, finlike extensions, and a tail or watery lower body.
monster:water demon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the water demon as a major humanoid demon that can swim and use weapons.
monster:water demon.modelBrief: Sculpt a lean amphibious demon with blue-purple skin, narrow head, webbed or finlike limbs, and dark watery shading.

monster:amorous demon.visualDescription: One slot shows a pale humanoid framed by large dark wings; the paired slot shows a darker flying humanoid with gray wings and a long tail.
monster:amorous demon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki groups incubi and succubi as foocubi; amorous demon is the gender-neutral monster name in current source.
monster:amorous demon.modelBrief: Build two closely related winged humanoid demon variants for tiles 594 and 595, retaining their distinct silhouettes, skin tones, wing shapes, and tail treatment.

monster:horned devil.visualDescription: A brown horned humanoid demon stands with enormous pale bat wings, clawed feet, and a long thin tail.
monster:horned devil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a thick-skinned horned devil with weapon, claw, bite, and tail attacks.
monster:horned devil.modelBrief: Build an upright brown devil with long horns, huge tan wing membranes, claws, and tapering tail; make wings the dominant shape.

monster:erinys.visualDescription: A red-haired female demon stands upright in dark purple clothing, carrying a curved gold weapon or staff.
monster:erinys.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies erinyes as three female humanoid major demons with poisonous weapon attacks.
monster:erinys.modelBrief: Model a stern humanoid woman with red hair, dark dress or armor, and a hooked gold weapon; avoid adding wings absent from the tile.

monster:barbed devil.visualDescription: A yellow-brown crouched demon is covered in long backward spikes, with narrow limbs and an elongated spiny head.
monster:barbed devil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a thick-skinned lawful major demon with barbed anatomy and multiple attacks.
monster:barbed devil.modelBrief: Sculpt a low muscular body bristling with sharp ochre spines from head, back, arms, and tail; preserve the tangled thorn silhouette.

monster:marilith.visualDescription: A red-brown female demon rises from a coiled serpent tail, with several arms fanned outward holding curved blades.
monster:marilith.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes mariliths as major demons with six rapid attacks using weapons and claws.
monster:marilith.modelBrief: Build a humanoid upper body with multiple blade-bearing arms over a thick coiled snake lower body; count and pose the arms for a readable fan.

monster:vrock.visualDescription: A magenta-red birdlike demon has a long hooked beak, broad ragged wings, clawed limbs, and a tapering tail.
monster:vrock.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the vrock as a major demon with multiple claws and a bite.
monster:vrock.modelBrief: Sculpt a predatory vulturelike demon with red feathered wings, beak, talons, and narrow body; keep the raised-wing silhouette.

monster:hezrou.visualDescription: A squat olive-brown demon lurches forward with thick arms, red open mouth, small horns, and heavy feet.
monster:hezrou.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the hezrou as a humanoid major demon with two claw attacks and a bite.
monster:hezrou.modelBrief: Build a bulky toadlike humanoid demon with broad shoulders, small horns, red maw, and muddy olive hide.

monster:bone devil.visualDescription: A pale bony demon has long hooked horns, an exposed riblike torso, narrow claws, and a spined tail.
monster:bone devil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the bone devil as a major demon that uses a weapon and poisonous sting.
monster:bone devil.modelBrief: Sculpt a skeletal beige devil with rib cage, long horns, thin limbs, and sharp tail tip; keep the brittle bone silhouette.

monster:ice devil.visualDescription: A slate-blue angular demon has huge backward horns, long blade-like arms, sharp knees, and a crouched insectoid body.
monster:ice devil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies an ice devil with claw, bite, and cold sting attacks.
monster:ice devil.modelBrief: Build a dark blue chitinous devil with high horns, mantis-like forearms, pointed legs, and frosty pale highlights.

monster:nalfeshnee.visualDescription: A heavy reddish demon has a boarlike face, black horns or wings, broad belly, long clawed hands, and short legs.
monster:nalfeshnee.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the nalfeshnee as a spellcasting humanoid major demon.
monster:nalfeshnee.modelBrief: Model a thick-bodied red boar-faced demon with horned head, dark wing stubs, belly folds, and broad claws.

monster:pit fiend.visualDescription: A large crimson devil stands in profile with swept horns, thick torso, clawed feet, and huge red bat wings.
monster:pit fiend.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the pit fiend as a major demon with weapon and crushing grab attacks.
monster:pit fiend.modelBrief: Sculpt a broad muscular devil with dark red skin, long horns, huge leathery wings, and heavy hands capable of gripping.

monster:sandestin.visualDescription: A pale cyan-white slender humanoid floats above the floor with a narrow head, long arms, and tapered legs.
monster:sandestin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the sandestin as a strong humanoid shapeshifter in the demon monster class but not itself a demon.
monster:sandestin.modelBrief: Model the pale default form as a tall thin spectral humanoid with blue edges and floating feet; allow later shape changes.

monster:balrog.visualDescription: A massive brown demon carries a long dark weapon, with broad hunched shoulders, fiery orange rim light, horns, and heavy legs.
monster:balrog.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the balrog as a flying, fire-resistant major demon and a physically imposing non-unique foe.
monster:balrog.modelBrief: Build an oversized horned demon with powerful limbs, dark weapon, brown hide, and orange flame accents around its silhouette.

monster:Juiblex.visualDescription: A towering blue-black amorphous mass sprouts many tendrils, glowing green spots, and a dripping turquoise lower body.
monster:Juiblex.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Juiblex as a unique amorphous demon lord with amphibious movement.
monster:Juiblex.modelBrief: Sculpt a semi-fluid dark slime column with branching tentacles and teal-green inner glow; leave rigid skeletal anatomy absent.

monster:Yeenoghu.visualDescription: A large purple-red demon hunches with long arms, angular muzzle, dark mane, and heavy clawed feet.
monster:Yeenoghu.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Yeenoghu as a unique demon lord who can fly and wield weapons.
monster:Yeenoghu.modelBrief: Build a hulking hunched demon with canine-like head, long arms, crimson-purple hide, and dark ridge or mane.

monster:Orcus.visualDescription: A horned reddish demon prince has huge magenta wings, heavy central body, cloven-looking feet, and an aggressive pose.
monster:Orcus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Orcus as a powerful unique demon prince.
monster:Orcus.modelBrief: Sculpt a thick-bodied horned prince with large pink-red wing membranes, deep brown torso, and imposing front-facing stance.

monster:Geryon.visualDescription: A dark gray monstrous head or body crouches beneath two wide pink bat wings, with curved horns and a broad toothy mouth; paired tiles vary slightly.
monster:Geryon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Geryon as a demon prince who may appear through demon summoning.
monster:Geryon.modelBrief: Build a low broad dark demon with massive arched magenta wings, curved horns, and central jaw; compare tiles 626 and 627.

monster:Dispater.visualDescription: A tall humanoid demon wears violet lower robes and brown upper garments, with orange-red hair or horns and a formal upright stance.
monster:Dispater.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Dispater as a unique humanoid demon prince.
monster:Dispater.modelBrief: Model a regal infernal figure in layered purple robes, brown shoulders, and fiery orange head detail; retain a slim commanding posture.

monster:Baalzebub.visualDescription: A large brown insectlike demon has huge pale wings, red compound-looking eyes, a long snout, and clawed legs.
monster:Baalzebub.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Baalzebub as a demon prince encountered in Gehennom.
monster:Baalzebub.modelBrief: Sculpt a flylike demon prince with broad veined wings, red eyes, brown chitin, and clawed limbs; keep its insect head prominent.

monster:Asmodeus.visualDescription: A red horned ruler in dark crimson robes raises one hand with a violet flame or orb, above a broad lower garment.
monster:Asmodeus.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Asmodeus as a powerful humanoid demon prince with a lair in Gehennom.
monster:Asmodeus.modelBrief: Build a regal devil with dark red skin, curled horns, heavy maroon robe, and raised purple magic in one hand.

monster:Demogorgon.visualDescription: A massive blue-gray demon has two dark heads, long curling tentacles, broad shoulders, and a deep mouthlike central darkness.
monster:Demogorgon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Demogorgon as a unique demon prince among the most dangerous monsters in the game.
monster:Demogorgon.modelBrief: Sculpt a towering two-headed, tentacle-armed demon with blue-gray hide and a wide intimidating stance; preserve the tangled silhouette.

monster:Death.visualDescription: A hooded black-robed figure floats with a pale skull face, dark blue robe fold, and long gray scythe.
monster:Death.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Death as one of the Riders, with lethal touch attacks.
monster:Death.modelBrief: Model a skeletal reaper in black-blue hood and long draping robe, holding a curved scythe; leave the face stark and pale.

monster:Pestilence.visualDescription: A green-faced hooded figure is wrapped in deep green robes, surrounded by drifting yellow-brown particles.
monster:Pestilence.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Pestilence as a Rider whose touch causes sickness.
monster:Pestilence.modelBrief: Build a hovering plague figure with green cowl, sickly face, dark robe, and sparse motes orbiting the body.

monster:Famine.visualDescription: A gaunt yellow skull and bony hand emerge from a black-brown cloak, with deep empty eye sockets.
monster:Famine.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Famine as a Rider whose touch drains nutrition.
monster:Famine.modelBrief: Sculpt a skeletal starved figure under ragged dark cloth, emphasizing hollow cheeks, long fingers, and exposed skull.

monster:mail daemon.visualDescription: A small red-brown horned demon has a long curling tail, pointed ears, bright yellow eyes, and a pale clawed hand extended in front. No mail item is visible in the tile.
monster:mail daemon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the mail daemon as a special messenger monster with no attacks.
monster:mail daemon.modelBrief: Build a compact red courier demon with horns, yellow eyes, pale claws, and a high curling tail. Keep its outstretched hand empty unless a separate mail-delivery animation needs a prop.

monster:djinni.visualDescription: A blue-purple humanoid floats above a dark shadow, with a tapering vapor-like lower body and arms spread wide.
monster:djinni.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies djinn as flying non-major-demon monsters that may emerge from magic sources.
monster:djinni.modelBrief: Model a broad-shouldered purple-blue spirit whose legs dissolve into a swirling lower wisp; keep arms and head clearly humanlike.

monster:jellyfish.visualDescription: A rust-red floating or swimming bell has a bright pale center and many dark dangling tentacles beneath it.
monster:jellyfish.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes a headless sea monster with tentacles rather than defined limbs.
monster:jellyfish.modelBrief: Build a rounded translucent red bell with luminous center and many trailing tentacles; pose it suspended in water.

monster:piranha.visualDescription: A small olive-brown fish has a blunt toothed mouth, dark eye, thick tail fin, and short dorsal fin.
monster:piranha.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the piranha as a small carnivorous sea monster with a bite attack.
monster:piranha.modelBrief: Sculpt a compact predatory fish with a large jaw, triangular fins, olive-gray scales, and a broad tail.

monster:shark.visualDescription: A slate-gray shark rises through blue water with an enormous open pink mouth, white teeth, pointed nose, and tall dorsal fin.
monster:shark.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes sharks as thick-skinned carnivorous sea monsters with strong bites.
monster:shark.modelBrief: Model a streamlined gray shark with tall dorsal fin, pale belly, and wide tooth-lined maw; match the upward breaching pose.

monster:giant eel.visualDescription: A thick brown eel curves up from blue water, with a long neck, red upper ridge, toothy yellow snout, and spotted body.
monster:giant eel.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the giant eel as a water-hiding carnivorous sea monster.
monster:giant eel.modelBrief: Build a long flexible eel with mottled brown scales, red dorsal line, and broad toothed head; allow the body to bend above water.

monster:electric eel.visualDescription: A long dark olive eel loops through blue water, showing a pale underbelly, yellow eye, and narrow finlike tail.
monster:electric eel.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes an oviparous electric eel whose bite can shock and whose body can wrap around a target.
monster:electric eel.modelBrief: Model an elongated coiling eel with olive back, pale belly, yellow eye, and narrow tail. The bright blue pixels are surrounding water; reserve electricity for an attack effect rather than permanent body edging.

monster:kraken.visualDescription: A huge olive-brown sea beast rises from water with a blunt face, red eyes, and several thick curling arms.
monster:kraken.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the kraken as the strongest sea monster, with claw, holding, and bite attacks.
monster:kraken.modelBrief: Sculpt a massive tentacled aquatic body with thick arms, olive hide, red eyes, and wet highlights; emphasize grasping reach.

monster:newt.visualDescription: A tiny dark blue-gray amphibian lies low with a narrow head, short legs, and tapering tail.
monster:newt.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the newt as a small amphibious lizard common early in the dungeon.
monster:newt.modelBrief: Build a low smooth-skinned newt with short splayed legs, long tail, and dark slate coloring.

monster:gecko.visualDescription: A small golden-yellow lizard crouches with broad head, short limbs, long upward tail, and pale belly.
monster:gecko.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the gecko as a small carnivorous lizard.
monster:gecko.modelBrief: Model a compact yellow gecko with wide head, toe pads, light belly, and curled tail; retain its low pose.

monster:iguana.visualDescription: A dark teal lizard has a ridged back, blunt snout, thick legs, and long curling tail.
monster:iguana.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the iguana as a small lizard often found in early dungeon floors.
monster:iguana.modelBrief: Sculpt a stocky teal iguana with a small dorsal crest, scaly body, robust feet, and long tail.

monster:baby crocodile.visualDescription: A little dark gray crocodilian has a long snout, short legs, bright eye, and thin tail.
monster:baby crocodile.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the baby crocodile as the juvenile amphibious crocodile with a bite attack.
monster:baby crocodile.modelBrief: Make a small low crocodile with narrow snout, short limbs, armored dark scales, and sweeping tail.

monster:lizard.visualDescription: A dark plum-brown small lizard curls into a compact shape with pointed nose, four tiny feet, and long tail.
monster:lizard.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the lizard as a tiny carnivorous member of its monster class, notable for stoning resistance.
monster:lizard.modelBrief: Build a little ground-hugging lizard with smooth dark scales and long curling tail; avoid oversized dragon features.

monster:chameleon.visualDescription: A bright turquoise reptile has a high back, dark body, large eye, and tight spiral tail.
monster:chameleon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the chameleon as a lizard shapeshifter that regularly changes form.
monster:chameleon.modelBrief: Model the shown turquoise base form with bulbous eye, arched body, grasping feet, and tightly curled tail; leave room for color-shift animation.

monster:crocodile.visualDescription: A large blue-gray crocodilian bends in a C shape with heavy jaws, armored ridged back, thick limbs, and long tail.
monster:crocodile.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the crocodile as a strong amphibious carnivore with bite and claw attacks.
monster:crocodile.modelBrief: Sculpt a long low crocodile with powerful toothed jaws, raised back scutes, thick feet, and long turning tail.

monster:salamander.visualDescription: A red fiery reptilian humanoid rises from a coiled lower body, with long snout, arm, and orange-yellow flame accents.
monster:salamander.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies salamanders as fiery humanoid reptiles that attack with weapons and fire.
monster:salamander.modelBrief: Build a red serpentine humanoid with upright torso, reptile head, coiled tail, and restrained orange fire along the crest.

monster:long worm tail.visualDescription: The tile is a large orange-brown rounded worm-body segment with a textured yellow top and darker lower edge; no head is visible.
monster:long worm tail.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki explains that a long worm's body extends across multiple map squares behind its head.
monster:long worm tail.modelBrief: Treat this as a repeatable body or tail segment, not a standalone creature; match the rounded orange scale pattern to the long-worm head asset.

monster:archeologist.visualDescription: A tan-clothed explorer wears a brown brimmed hat and carries a black whip; paired sprites differ in face and hair detail.
monster:archeologist.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Archeologist as a playable role and notes a corresponding player monster.
monster:archeologist.modelBrief: Build a practical explorer with brimmed hat, brown vest, tan trousers, boots, and coiled whip; support both visible head variants.

monster:barbarian.visualDescription: A bare-armed muscular fighter in brown trousers raises a heavy gray axe, with warm skin and a dark belt; paired heads differ.
monster:barbarian.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Barbarian as a playable combat role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:barbarian.modelBrief: Model a broad-shouldered warrior with exposed arms, leather belt and boots, and oversized single axe; preserve both head variants.

monster:cave dweller.visualDescription: A rough-clothed human raises a wooden club, wearing an ochre hide tunic and short dark skirt; the paired figures differ in head and build.
monster:cave dweller.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Cave Dweller as the role whose male and female names are Caveman and Cavewoman, with a corresponding player monster.
monster:cave dweller.modelBrief: Build a primitive adventurer in animal-hide clothing carrying a large club; use paired head and body details for the two slots.

monster:healer.visualDescription: A hooded figure in pale gray robes has a dark face opening, blue-red belt accent, satchel, and raised hands.
monster:healer.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Healer as a playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:healer.modelBrief: Model a traveling healer with light hood and robe, visible pouch or medical satchel, and open hands; keep the blue-red waist accent.

monster:knight.visualDescription: A helmeted armored fighter stands with a long gray sword and small dark blue shield, wearing brown trousers.
monster:knight.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Knight as a human playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:knight.modelBrief: Build a compact mail-clad knight with steel helmet, upright sword, blue shield, and sturdy boots.

monster:monk.visualDescription: A human martial artist in loose rust-orange robes adopts a wide fighting stance with both fists raised; paired heads differ.
monster:monk.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Monk as a playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:monk.modelBrief: Sculpt an unarmed fighter in orange wrap robe, sash, and wide stance; support both face and hair variants.

monster:cleric.visualDescription: A robed human in light gray-white vestments carries a dark staff or mace and a brown pouch; paired heads and garments differ.
monster:cleric.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Cleric as a playable religious role with a corresponding player monster, distinct from temple aligned clerics.
monster:cleric.modelBrief: Build a traveling cleric with pale robe, belt pouch, dark hand weapon, and the paired face or robe variants.

monster:ranger.visualDescription: A green-hooded adventurer wears brown and green field clothes, standing with arms raised and a dark weapon at each side.
monster:ranger.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Ranger as a playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:ranger.modelBrief: Model a nimble hooded ranger with green cowl, brown leather layers, boots, and practical hand weapons; keep the face mostly shaded.

monster:rogue.visualDescription: A dark-haired human in gray and brown light armor stands with a curved short blade, side pouch, and dark boots; paired heads differ.
monster:rogue.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Rogue as a playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:rogue.modelBrief: Build a lean thief with dark vest, gray shoulder armor, belt pouch, and short blade; preserve the two head variants.

monster:samurai.visualDescription: A dark-haired warrior wears a flowing indigo-purple upper cloak over brown lower robes and carries a curved sword; paired faces differ subtly.
monster:samurai.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Samurai as a human playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:samurai.modelBrief: Sculpt layered robe and armor, a purple mantle, black hair, and curved sword; keep both facial variants available.

monster:tourist.visualDescription: A casually dressed human wears a bright red patterned shirt, tan shorts, white shoes, and carries a black camera; paired faces differ.
monster:tourist.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Tourist as a playable role with a corresponding player monster.
monster:tourist.modelBrief: Model a lightly equipped traveler with red print shirt, shorts, sneakers, and a camera held forward; preserve paired face details.

monster:valkyrie.visualDescription: An armored female warrior carries a long gray sword and round red shield, with pale tunic, brown boots, and long hair; paired hair differs.
monster:valkyrie.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Valkyrie as a playable warrior role with a corresponding player monster; Valkyrie heroes always start female.
monster:valkyrie.modelBrief: Build a female armored fighter with white-gray breastplate, round red shield, sword, boots, and both hair variants.

monster:wizard.visualDescription: A hooded violet-blue spellcaster raises a staff beside bright cyan magical energy, with dark face and layered robes.
monster:wizard.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Wizard as a playable magic role with a corresponding player monster.
