monster:wizard.modelBrief: Model a slender robed caster with blue-purple hood, red-brown staff, dark face shadow, and cyan spell effect.

monster:Lord Carnarvon.visualDescription: A tall gray-suited explorer wears a pale brimmed hat, red neckerchief, and dark boots, holding a rectangular case.
monster:Lord Carnarvon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Lord Carnarvon as the Archeologist quest leader.
monster:Lord Carnarvon.modelBrief: Build an older expedition patron in gray coat and hat, red scarf, boots, and hand case; keep his upright formal stance.

monster:Pelias.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered fighter with long dark hair carries a large gray axe, brown armor, and blue-gray trousers.
monster:Pelias.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Pelias as the Barbarian quest leader with strong weapon attacks.
monster:Pelias.modelBrief: Sculpt an imposing barbarian elder with long hair, rugged brown armor, oversized axe, and heavy boots.

monster:Shaman Karnov.visualDescription: A bearded elder in pale wide-brimmed headgear and rust-red robe holds a crooked staff, with exposed tan arms.
monster:Shaman Karnov.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Shaman Karnov as the Cave Dweller quest leader.
monster:Shaman Karnov.modelBrief: Build a stocky tribal shaman with pale cap, broad beard, reddish garment, and branched wooden staff.

monster:Earendil.visualDescription: A golden-haired elf in blue-gray armor stands with an orange shield, dark cloak, and thin sword.
monster:Earendil.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki records Earendil as the former male Elf quest leader in older NetHack versions.
monster:Earendil.modelBrief: Model a tall golden-haired elven leader with blue armor, warm round shield, slender sword, and dark cloak; label as legacy quest art.

monster:Elwing.visualDescription: A dark-haired woman wears a pale gray robe and darker apronlike panel, standing calmly with hands near her sides.
monster:Elwing.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki's Elf quest page identifies Elwing as the former female Elf quest leader.
monster:Elwing.modelBrief: Build a restrained elven noblewoman with dark shoulder-length hair, pale layered dress, and dark waist panel; keep her distinct from Earendil.

monster:Hippocrates.visualDescription: A blond bearded man in long indigo-blue robes stands with one hand lifted and pale underlayers visible.
monster:Hippocrates.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Hippocrates as the Healer quest leader, who uses clerical spells.
monster:Hippocrates.modelBrief: Sculpt a learned healer with blond beard, blue robe, pale inner garment, and an open teaching gesture.

monster:King Arthur.visualDescription: A crowned bearded king wears gold armor and a deep red cape, raising a long silver sword beside a dark shield.
monster:King Arthur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies King Arthur as the Knight quest leader with two strong weapon attacks.
monster:King Arthur.modelBrief: Build a regal armored king with gold crown, red mantle, long sword, and shield; keep the broad authoritative silhouette.

monster:Grand Master.visualDescription: An elderly bald man in brown-orange robes stands with arms crossed or held inside sleeves, with a long beard.
monster:Grand Master.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Grand Master as the Monk quest leader.
monster:Grand Master.modelBrief: Model an aged martial arts master with wrapped brown robe, long white beard, calm posture, and no prominent weapon.

monster:Arch Priest.visualDescription: A pale-haired cleric wears ornate magenta and gold vestments and holds a gold-topped staff.
monster:Arch Priest.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Arch Priest as the Priest or Cleric quest leader, similar in abilities to a high cleric.
monster:Arch Priest.modelBrief: Sculpt a senior cleric in bright gold-trimmed purple robe, white stole, tall headdress, and ceremonial staff.

monster:Orion.visualDescription: A red-hooded huntsman in rust clothing carries a tall curved bow and dark belt, standing with a broad stance.
monster:Orion.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Orion as the Ranger quest leader and a powerful human combatant.
monster:Orion.modelBrief: Build a seasoned archer with red hood, ochre leather layers, large bow, boots, and broad shoulders.

monster:Master of Thieves.visualDescription: A dark-haired man in simple brown tunic and trousers holds a short blade, one arm bent in a guarded pose.
monster:Master of Thieves.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Master of Thieves as the Rogue quest leader.
monster:Master of Thieves.modelBrief: Model a wary human thief leader with dark hair, brown sleeveless clothes, a short blade, and practical boots.

monster:Lord Sato.visualDescription: A gray-haired elder in long tan robes holds a dark sheathed or drawn sword, with a dark sash and calm stance.
monster:Lord Sato.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Lord Sato as the Samurai quest leader with two weapon attacks.
monster:Lord Sato.modelBrief: Sculpt an older samurai lord with pale hair, layered tan robes, dark sash, and long sword; emphasize composure over motion.

monster:Twoflower.visualDescription: A lightly dressed traveler wears a brown brimmed hat, bright blue-purple patterned shirt, tan shorts, and small shoes.
monster:Twoflower.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Twoflower as the Tourist quest leader.
monster:Twoflower.modelBrief: Model a cheerful tourist with straw hat, colorful short-sleeved shirt, shorts, and casual stance; echo the Tourist role without copying it exactly.

monster:Norn.visualDescription: A red-haired woman in a long dark brown cloak stands with a strong upright stance and warm red inner garment.
monster:Norn.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Norn as the Valkyrie quest leader and a powerful human woman.
monster:Norn.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall mature woman with red hair, dark cloak, reddish dress or armor, and grounded commanding posture.

monster:Neferet the Green.visualDescription: A dark-faced hooded sorceress wears bright emerald robes and raises a staff with a violet orb.
monster:Neferet the Green.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Neferet the Green as the Wizard quest leader, a strong human spellcaster.
monster:Neferet the Green.modelBrief: Build a robed mage with vivid green hood and layered skirt, dark face shadow, and purple-topped staff.

monster:Minion of Huhetotl.visualDescription: A lean crimson demon with long arms, pointed ears or horns, and a red loincloth holds a staff or blade in one hand.
monster:Minion of Huhetotl.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Minion of Huhetotl as the Archeologist quest nemesis and a unique major demon.
monster:Minion of Huhetotl.modelBrief: Sculpt a tall red demon with angular limbs, narrow head, dark claws, and an upright weapon; preserve the thin silhouette.

monster:Thoth Amon.visualDescription: A dark-robed sorcerer wears a gold crown or hood, raises both arms, and holds two green-glowing staff tips.
monster:Thoth Amon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Thoth Amon as the Barbarian quest nemesis, a covetous human spellcaster.
monster:Thoth Amon.modelBrief: Model a human mage in indigo and gold robes with raised arms and two green magical accents; retain the strong shoulder silhouette.

monster:Chromatic Dragon.visualDescription: A crouched dark blue dragon has bright magenta neck and wing, yellow-pink patterned membrane, and a massive horned head.
monster:Chromatic Dragon.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Chromatic Dragon as the Cave Dweller quest nemesis and a unique dragon also known as Tiamat.
monster:Chromatic Dragon.modelBrief: Build a large multi-colored dragon with deep blue body, pink-magenta head and wings, golden membrane patches, heavy claws, and curled tail.

monster:Goblin King.visualDescription: A small olive-green goblin wears a tall gold crown and carries a dark sword, with a long nose and thin limbs.
monster:Goblin King.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki records the Goblin King as a former unique Elf quest nemesis.
monster:Goblin King.modelBrief: Model a spindly green goblin with oversized golden crown, pointed nose, and dark sword; label as legacy quest art.

monster:Cyclops.visualDescription: A huge bald orange-pink giant has one central eye, broad arms, round torso, and small brown loincloth.
monster:Cyclops.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Cyclops as the unique Healer quest nemesis and a giant.
monster:Cyclops.modelBrief: Sculpt a massive one-eyed humanoid with broad chest, pink-orange skin, huge hands, and simple loincloth.

monster:Ixoth.visualDescription: A tall crimson dragon rears with a long neck, wings, powerful hind legs, claws, and curling tail.
monster:Ixoth.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Ixoth as the unique red dragon guarding the Knight quest.
monster:Ixoth.modelBrief: Build a large red dragon with extended neck, raised wings, horned head, heavy claws, and long coiled tail; differentiate it from baby red dragons by scale.

monster:Master Kaen.visualDescription: A stern bare-armed human monk has pale skin, dark hair, gray upper wrap, red lower robe, and squared fighting pose.
monster:Master Kaen.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Master Kaen as the Monk quest nemesis, a human martial artist.
monster:Master Kaen.modelBrief: Model an older formidable monk with gray chest wrap, red trousers, exposed arms, and planted fighting stance.

monster:Nalzok.visualDescription: A gray-brown horned beastlike demon crouches with long clawed forelimbs, ridged back, and a broad red mouth.
monster:Nalzok.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Nalzok as the Priest quest nemesis and a unique major demon.
monster:Nalzok.modelBrief: Sculpt a powerful quadrupedal-looking demon with curved horns, heavy shoulders, gray-brown hide, and red maw; keep the low predatory pose.

monster:Scorpius.visualDescription: An enormous purple-black scorpion has huge pale front claws, curled segmented tail, and broad armored body.
monster:Scorpius.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Scorpius as the Ranger quest nemesis and a unique giant scorpion.
monster:Scorpius.modelBrief: Build a massive scorpion with thick violet carapace, oversized pale pincers, eight legs, and raised stinging tail.

monster:Master Assassin.visualDescription: A near-black hooded killer stands with a dark cape, red hands or blades, and a pointed weapon in each hand.
monster:Master Assassin.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Master Assassin as the Rogue quest nemesis and a strong human.
monster:Master Assassin.modelBrief: Build a lean masked assassin in black layered cloth with two short red-edged weapons and low threatening stance.

monster:Ashikaga Takauji.visualDescription: A helmeted samurai wears dark red armor over gray garments, carries a curved sword, and has a broad red lower silhouette.
monster:Ashikaga Takauji.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies Ashikaga Takauji as the Samurai quest nemesis and a human swordsman.
monster:Ashikaga Takauji.modelBrief: Sculpt a heavily armored samurai lord with horned helmet, red lacquered armor, curved katana, and dark boots.

monster:Lord Surtur.visualDescription: An immense crimson giant is almost a wall of fire, with huge shoulders, broad jaw, orange highlights, and heavy legs.
monster:Lord Surtur.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes Lord Surtur as the Valkyrie quest nemesis and a unique fire giant.
monster:Lord Surtur.modelBrief: Build a towering muscular fire giant in deep red with orange glowing seams, large head, and massive hands; keep the sprite's blocky bulk.

monster:Dark One.visualDescription: A small gray-robed figure sits or crouches with a black hooded face and reddish hands, framed by a dark stone-like base.
monster:Dark One.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the Dark One as the Wizard quest nemesis, a human magic user.
monster:Dark One.modelBrief: Model a compact sinister hooded mage with layered gray robe, deep black facial void, and low seated or crouched posture.

monster:student.visualDescription: A young brown-haired human in tan and gray clothes stands beside a broad dark blue shape with a bright blue tip at shoulder height. The small tile does not clearly identify that shape as a particular tool.
monster:student.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the student as an Archeologist quest guardian.
monster:student.modelBrief: Build a junior explorer in tan field clothes with brown hair and boots. Keep the dark blue shoulder-height shape as a simple separate prop until its identity can be confirmed from the source art.

monster:chieftain.visualDescription: A muscular fighter with gray helmet wears brown leather and fur, holding a curved weapon and standing wide.
monster:chieftain.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the chieftain as a Barbarian quest guardian.
monster:chieftain.modelBrief: Sculpt a robust tribal warrior with horned gray helmet, leather torso, fur accents, and broad curved blade.

monster:neanderthal.visualDescription: A shaggy orange-brown prehistoric human wears a rough green hide and grips a tall wooden club.
monster:neanderthal.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the neanderthal as a Cave Dweller quest guardian.
monster:neanderthal.modelBrief: Build a heavy browed, hairy human with crude hide clothing, bare limbs, and oversized club.

monster:High-elf.visualDescription: A fair-haired elf wears blue-green and gold armor with a brown cape, holding a thin silver blade.
monster:High-elf.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the High-elf as a deferred elven monster that formerly served as an Elf quest guardian.
monster:High-elf.modelBrief: Model a tall elegant elf with blond hair, blue and gold layered armor, cape, and slender sword; label as legacy tile art.

monster:attendant.visualDescription: A plain-clothed human in tan and gray stands with short dark hair, pale sleeves, and a small red item in hand.
monster:attendant.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the attendant as a Healer quest guardian.
monster:attendant.modelBrief: Build an unarmored medical helper in simple tan robe and pale sleeves, with a small red supply item.

monster:page.visualDescription: A youthful short human wears a green tunic over gray trousers, with brown hair and a small side weapon.
monster:page.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the page as a Knight quest guardian with two weapon attacks.
monster:page.modelBrief: Model a young squire in green tunic, belt, gray leggings, and light boots; keep the proportions less armored than a knight.

monster:abbot.visualDescription: An elder in long rust-red robes has a pale bald head or cap, dark brown beard, and hands close to the body.
monster:abbot.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the abbot as a Monk quest guardian able to fight and cast clerical spells.
monster:abbot.modelBrief: Sculpt a calm senior monk in dark red-brown robe with pale head and simple wrap; avoid conspicuous weapons.

monster:acolyte.visualDescription: A pale gray-robed figure has a black hooded face, white shoulder cloth, brown belt, and long skirt.
monster:acolyte.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the acolyte as a Cleric quest guardian, distinct from the Cleric role's rank title.
monster:acolyte.modelBrief: Build a junior temple cleric in white-gray hooded vestments with dark face opening and simple belt.

monster:hunter.visualDescription: A dark-haired human wears a brown-green short tunic over blue-gray trousers, with a tan shoulder wrap and boots.
monster:hunter.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the hunter as a Ranger quest guardian.
monster:hunter.modelBrief: Build a practical field hunter with dark hair, brown vest, green scarf, blue trousers, and light equipment; keep a ready standing pose.

monster:thug.visualDescription: A rough human with brown cap wears dark blue-gray chest armor, reddish sleeves, and brown trousers, with one hand raised.
monster:thug.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki describes the thug as a Rogue quest guardian with two weapon attacks.
monster:thug.modelBrief: Model a stocky street fighter in dark vest, brown hat, rolled sleeves, and sturdy boots; give the hands room to hold paired weapons.

monster:ninja.visualDescription: A black-blue masked figure crouches with one arm raised and a dark blade, wrapped in layered stealth clothing.
monster:ninja.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies ninja as strong human Samurai quest guardians with two weapon attacks and thrown weapon skills.
monster:ninja.modelBrief: Build a low crouched masked fighter with navy wrappings, short blades, and small visible eyes; preserve the dynamic silhouette.

monster:roshi.visualDescription: An elder in blue-black robes has a pale face, long gray hair, and a dark sword held near the body.
monster:roshi.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the roshi as a Samurai quest guardian with two weapon attacks.
monster:roshi.modelBrief: Sculpt an aged swordsman in dark indigo robes with gray hair, calm posture, and sheathed or lowered blade.

monster:guide.visualDescription: A human traveler wears a green coat, pale scarf, tan trousers, and dark shoes, standing upright with one hand lowered.
monster:guide.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the guide as a Tourist quest guardian.
monster:guide.modelBrief: Model a helpful traveler in green jacket and cream scarf, with tan trousers and ordinary walking shoes.

monster:warrior.visualDescription: A tall blond woman in bronze-red armor stands wide with a long gray sword and dark red lower garments.
monster:warrior.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the warrior as a Valkyrie quest guardian and a female human.
monster:warrior.modelBrief: Build a sturdy armored woman with blond hair, copper-brown breastplate, red leggings, and raised sword.

monster:apprentice.visualDescription: A young brown-haired human wears an olive-green robe and cap, carrying a dark book or satchel at the side.
monster:apprentice.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki identifies the apprentice as a Wizard quest guardian who can collect magical items.
monster:apprentice.modelBrief: Model a junior mage in simple green clothes with brown hair, belt, and carried book or pouch; keep less ornament than the Wizard.

monster:invisible monster, nogender.visualDescription: The tile shows a large white question mark with a dark shadow on the blue-gray patterned ground; it gives no anatomical evidence.
monster:invisible monster, nogender.wikiDescription: NetHack Wiki explains invisibility as a property that hides a monster from observers; this atlas entry is a visibility placeholder rather than a creature species.
monster:invisible monster, nogender.modelBrief: Do not invent a fixed creature mesh from the question mark. Use it as a visibility or unknown-identity marker and choose the underlying monster's model only after its identity is known.

object:strange object.visualDescription: A squat dark brown chest-like box sits below a bright ochre lid, with a narrow red slit and a pale glint near the front. It is the only pictorial tile in this first group; the teal pattern behind it is background.
object:strange object.wikiDescription: The wiki notes that a strange-object display can indicate an object-disguised mimic. This atlas label is anomalous and should not be treated as a normal, identified chest item.
object:strange object.modelBrief: Build a compact box silhouette with a thick gold-brown lid, dark recessed front, and tiny red and pale accents. Keep the mystery of the source marker; avoid adding chest hardware that the tile does not show.

object:strange / generic strange.visualDescription: A single pale cream right bracket with a dark blue-gray pixel outline occupies the center. It is a class marker rather than a pictured object.
object:strange / generic strange.wikiDescription: The wiki explains that the right-square-bracket glyph can mark a strange object or an object-disguised mimic. This generic slot therefore has no fixed material or item effect.
object:strange / generic strange.modelBrief: If a 3D icon is needed, make a thin upright bracket-shaped token with a cream face and dark edge. Preserve the abstract marker; do not invent a physical strange item.

object:weapon / generic weapon.visualDescription: A pale right parenthesis with a dark blue-gray outline appears alone in the tile. It has no blade, hilt, or other physical weapon detail.
object:weapon / generic weapon.wikiDescription: NetHack uses the weapon class for items used to attack opponents. This is the generic class icon, not one named weapon.
object:weapon / generic weapon.modelBrief: Represent the exact curved parenthesis as a shallow, readable cream-and-dark token if this fallback glyph must have depth. Keep named weapons in their separate tiles.

object:armor / generic armor.visualDescription: A squared, open cream bracket with a dark outline stands upright against the patterned field. No suit of armor is depicted.
object:armor / generic armor.wikiDescription: Armor is NetHack's wearable defensive item class and spans several equipment slots. This slot is a generic symbol, so it does not prescribe an armor shape.
object:armor / generic armor.modelBrief: Use a thin bracket-shaped fallback marker with the same pale face and dark rim. Do not turn the marker into an arbitrary helmet or cuirass.

object:ring / generic ring.visualDescription: A large cream equals-like ring glyph forms an octagonal loop with a dark central opening and blue-gray outline. It is deliberately schematic.
object:ring / generic ring.wikiDescription: Rings are wearable magical items in NetHack and may confer different effects. Their individual unidentified appearances are separate from this generic class marker.
object:ring / generic ring.modelBrief: Make a thick flat octagonal loop or low relief icon with a clear central hole. Keep its cream and slate colors, and avoid gemstones or effects that imply a particular ring.

object:amulet / generic amulet.visualDescription: Two short cream strokes lean together like an oversized quotation mark, edged in dark blue-gray. There is no pendant or cord in the tile.
object:amulet / generic amulet.wikiDescription: Amulets are a NetHack item class worn around the neck. This generic class glyph does not identify any particular amulet or its power.
object:amulet / generic amulet.modelBrief: Treat the two pale strokes as a shallow paired icon. Preserve their separation and diagonal tilt; reserve necklace geometry for the specific amulet tiles.

object:tool / generic tool.visualDescription: A cream left parenthesis with a dark blue-gray outline stands alone. The curved stroke is a symbol, not a pictured implement.
object:tool / generic tool.wikiDescription: NetHack tools are miscellaneous usable items, including containers, lights, and musical instruments. The class itself has no single physical form.
object:tool / generic tool.modelBrief: Give the curved glyph slight thickness as a fallback icon, keeping its open side and cream face clear. Avoid choosing a specific tool for this generic slot.

object:food / generic food.visualDescription: A pale percent sign with two square-ended dots and a diagonal slash fills the cell. It is abstract and shows no edible object.
object:food / generic food.wikiDescription: The wiki calls edible items comestibles; they provide nutrition or other effects when eaten. This percent-sign tile marks the class as a whole.
object:food / generic food.modelBrief: Create a low relief percent-sign token with two separated dots and a crisp diagonal stroke. Do not model an arbitrary ration or fruit in place of the glyph.

object:potion / generic potion.visualDescription: A pale exclamation mark has a tall rectangular stroke and detached square dot, both outlined in blue-gray. It is a punctuation marker, not a bottle.
object:potion / generic potion.wikiDescription: Potions are quaffed magical drinks in NetHack, and their visible appearances can be randomized. The generic class marker does not specify a potion color or effect.
object:potion / generic potion.modelBrief: Extrude the two separate punctuation shapes as a shallow cream-faced icon. Keep vial silhouettes for the later appearance-specific potion tiles.

object:scroll / generic scroll.visualDescription: A large cream question mark with a detached dot and a dark pixel edge sits at center. It has no paper or lettering.
object:scroll / generic scroll.wikiDescription: A NetHack scroll produces magic when read and is then consumed. This generic question mark stands for the class, while individual scroll appearances are separate.
object:scroll / generic scroll.modelBrief: Use a shallow question-mark relief, preserving the hook and isolated lower dot. Do not invent a scroll roll for the fallback class marker.

object:spellbook / generic spellbook.visualDescription: A pale plus sign with broad straight bars and a dark blue-gray outline is the whole foreground. No book is drawn.
object:spellbook / generic spellbook.wikiDescription: Spellbooks are the NetHack item class used mainly to learn or cast spells. The class sign does not identify a spellbook title or binding.
object:spellbook / generic spellbook.modelBrief: Make a simple shallow cross-shaped marker with thick equal bars and a dark rim. Keep named spellbooks as distinct objects elsewhere in the atlas.

object:wand / generic wand.visualDescription: A thin pale diagonal slash with a dark lower-right edge crosses the cell. It is schematic and has no handle or ornament.
object:wand / generic wand.wikiDescription: NetHack wands are limited-use magical items that can be zapped or engraved with. A generic slash gives no clue to an individual wand's randomized appearance.
object:wand / generic wand.modelBrief: Use a narrow diagonal rod with a square pixel-like profile and pale face. Keep this fallback symbol plain rather than assigning wood, crystal, or a specific wand effect.

object:coin / generic coin.visualDescription: A single large pale dollar sign with thick dark pixel edges fills the cell. It is a currency symbol rather than a coin with a visible face.
object:coin / generic coin.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the gold piece as NetHack's coinage, valued in zorkmids. This generic class tile gives no stamped design or pile size.
object:coin / generic coin.modelBrief: Use a shallow cream-colored dollar-sign marker with a heavy dark edge for the generic slot. Reserve round coins or piles for an appearance-specific tile.

object:gem / generic gem.visualDescription: A large cream asterisk has uneven pointed arms and a dark blue-gray outline. There is no cut-stone shape or color in the tile.
object:gem / generic gem.wikiDescription: NetHack gems include several kinds of small stones, some valuable and some not. This is the class marker, not an identified jewel.
object:gem / generic gem.modelBrief: Make a flat multi-pointed asterisk token with an open readable silhouette and cream face. Do not assign a gemstone cut, hue, or value to this generic marker.

object:large rock / generic large rock.visualDescription: A short, pale curved stroke resembling a backtick or small rock-class mark sits near the middle. It is not a rendered boulder.
object:large rock / generic large rock.wikiDescription: The wiki describes boulders as heavy rock objects that occupy dungeon squares. This tile is the generic large-rock class sign, not evidence for a particular stone surface.
object:large rock / generic large rock.modelBrief: Give the small hooked mark shallow depth as a class icon. Avoid building a full boulder from this abstract glyph alone; the actual boulder tile supplies that model reference.

object:iron ball / generic iron ball.visualDescription: A pale zero-like oval with a dark blue-gray interior and thick outline sits at center. It reads as a class symbol rather than a shaded sphere.
object:iron ball / generic iron ball.wikiDescription: The heavy iron ball is NetHack's iron-ball object type and is made of iron. The generic glyph gives only a circular cue, not a physical size or chain attachment.
object:iron ball / generic iron ball.modelBrief: If this class placeholder needs a 3D form, use a low-relief oval ring with a dark inset. Keep the full iron ball model for its object tile and do not attach an invented chain here.

object:iron chain / generic iron chain.visualDescription: A short, thick cream horizontal bar with a dark blue-gray lower edge crosses part of the cell. No separate links are drawn.
object:iron chain / generic iron chain.wikiDescription: An iron chain is a NetHack item associated with attaching a heavy iron ball. This class glyph supplies no link count or construction detail.
object:iron chain / generic iron chain.modelBrief: Use one shallow horizontal bar for the fallback class glyph; avoid interpreting it as a measured chain segment. A later physical chain model can use actual links while keeping this tile distinct.

object:venom / generic venom.visualDescription: One pale square-ish dot with a dark lower-right pixel shadow floats at center. It shows no splash, bottle, or creature.
object:venom / generic venom.wikiDescription: Venom is a NetHack object class for poisonous or acidic projectiles produced by monsters. This generic point is not a particular venom type.
object:venom / generic venom.modelBrief: Keep a tiny raised dot for the placeholder icon. Do not infer a color, container, or blob anatomy from this abstract tile.

object:arrow.visualDescription: A long brown wooden shaft runs diagonally from lower left to upper right, ending in a small pale arrowhead; a dark rear point suggests fletching.
object:arrow.wikiDescription: An arrow is stackable ammunition fired from a bow. The wiki distinguishes ordinary arrows from elven, orcish, silver, and ya varieties that follow it in the atlas.
object:arrow.modelBrief: Make a slender straight brown shaft, small pale metal point, and minimal dark fletching. Match the diagonal reference silhouette without embedding the patterned floor.

object:runed arrow / elven arrow.visualDescription: A brown diagonal shaft carries a vivid pale-green arrowhead and a dark lower-left tail. The tile's runed quality is conveyed by color more than legible markings.
object:runed arrow / elven arrow.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies an elven arrow as wooden bow ammunition that appears as a runed arrow when unidentified. The appearance label names the visible tile; no readable rune is evident in the sprite.
object:runed arrow / elven arrow.modelBrief: Keep the ordinary arrow proportions but add the distinct green-tinted point and restrained elven finish. Do not invent large symbols on this tiny design.

object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.visualDescription: A rough, dark brown shaft leans diagonally; the far upper-right end is broad and blunt-looking, while the near end is a small pale tip. It is much darker than the ordinary arrow.
object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.wikiDescription: An orcish arrow is projectile ammunition for an orcish bow and appears as a crude arrow. Its crude label supports rough construction, while the dark palette is from PixelHack.
object:crude arrow / orcish arrow.modelBrief: Use a slim but uneven wooden shaft with dark coarse fletching and a small light point. Keep it visibly rougher and browner than the standard arrow.

object:silver arrow.visualDescription: A cool gray-blue diagonal shaft with a light ivory tip and dark tail mirrors the ordinary arrow's length. Its metal-colored body is the main distinction.
object:silver arrow.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the silver arrow as a projectile made of silver. Its material matters in NetHack; the sprite uses pale gray to distinguish it from wooden arrows.
object:silver arrow.modelBrief: Use the regular arrow silhouette, replacing the warm shaft with silver-gray metal and a bright pale point. Keep the narrow proportions legible at tile scale.

object:bamboo arrow / ya.visualDescription: A short ochre-brown diagonal shaft has a pale point and darker lower-left tail. The warm bamboo color separates it from the gray silver arrow.

object:shiny / protection from shape cha.modelBrief: Use a smooth silver hoop with exaggerated white specular glints, reserving its effect for game logic. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Ring of protection from shape changers

object:circular / amulet of ESP.visualDescription: A long gold neck loop suspends a dark circular medallion with a blue-gray center.
object:circular / amulet of ESP.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of ESP grants telepathic awareness of nearby minds. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:circular / amulet of ESP.modelBrief: Make a round slate pendant on a golden cord or chain; keep ESP as a separate item property. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:spherical / amulet of life saving.visualDescription: A long golden neck loop holds a spherical dark blue-gray pendant with a white crosslike sparkle.
object:spherical / amulet of life saving.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of life saving prevents one fatal outcome and is then consumed. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:spherical / amulet of life saving.modelBrief: Build a round blue-gray pendant on a long gold cord, with a single white glint rather than a literal medical emblem. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of life saving

object:oval / amulet of strangulation.visualDescription: An oval slate pendant hangs from a broad gold loop, with a pale vertical oval highlight.
object:oval / amulet of strangulation.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of strangulation tightens around the wearer and can kill if not removed. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:oval / amulet of strangulation.modelBrief: Make a dark oval pendant on the standard gold cord; represent strangulation through gameplay, not a visibly closed noose. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.visualDescription: A dark triangular pendant hangs point-down from the same long gold neck loop.
object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of restful sleep periodically makes its wearer fall asleep. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:triangular / amulet of restful sl.modelBrief: Build a simple charcoal triangular medallion and gold cord with no sleep icon. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of restful sleep

object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.visualDescription: A narrow dark pyramid-like pendant points downward from a gold neck loop.
object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet versus poison grants poison resistance. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:pyramidal / amulet versus poison.modelBrief: Make a pointed gray pyramidal charm on the common gold cord; keep the protection effect separate. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:square / amulet of change.visualDescription: A gray square pendant is turned like a diamond beneath a long gold necklace loop.
object:square / amulet of change.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of change changes the wearer's sex when put on. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:square / amulet of change.modelBrief: Build a small four-cornered stone or metal medallion with dark edge and gold cord; keep transformation out of the mesh. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:concave / amulet of unchanging.visualDescription: A dark round concave pendant has a recessed pale center and hangs from a gold cord.
object:concave / amulet of unchanging.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of unchanging prevents form changes while worn. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:concave / amulet of unchanging.modelBrief: Create a shallow inward-bowled circular pendant with gray center and dark rim, suspended from the standard necklace. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.visualDescription: A gray six-sided pendant with pale upper facets hangs below a gold neck loop.
object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of reflection turns back ray and gaze attacks. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:hexagonal / amulet of reflection.modelBrief: Build a faceted hexagonal gray medallion with restrained pale highlights; avoid painting incoming rays on it. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.visualDescription: A broad pale gray octagonal charm with dark lower facets hangs from a long gold necklace.
object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of magical breathing lets its wearer breathe underwater and survive without air. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:octagonal / amulet of magical bre.modelBrief: Make a chunky eight-sided stone pendant with a simple gold cord, without bubbles fixed to the asset. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Amulet of magical breathing

object:perforated / amulet of guarding.visualDescription: A dark gray perforated charm is a small ring with a visible hole, suspended from gold cord.
object:perforated / amulet of guarding.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of guarding improves intrinsic protection. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:perforated / amulet of guarding.modelBrief: Model an open-centered dark medallion with thick rim; leave armor bonuses to item data. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:cubical / amulet of flying.visualDescription: A pale gray cube-shaped pendant with dark bottom facets hangs from the standard gold neck loop.
object:cubical / amulet of flying.wikiDescription: The wiki says an amulet of flying grants flight while worn. Its unidentified appearance is randomized; the catalog links this appearance to that effect by default.
object:cubical / amulet of flying.modelBrief: Make a small faceted cubic pendant with gold cord, keeping it as a worn item rather than a floating object. Model the visible appearance, with effect identity kept separate.

object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.wikiTitle: Cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.visualDescription: A dull gold circular amulet carries a bright red center and hangs from a tan neck cord.
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies this as a plastic imitation of the real Amulet of Yendor, sharing its apparent name until identified.
object:Amulet of Yendor / cheap plastic.modelBrief: Build a slightly dull, cheaper-looking round gold-colored frame with simple red inset; preserve its similarity to the real amulet.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Cheap plastic imitation of the Amulet of Yendor

object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.visualDescription: A richer round golden amulet has a deep crimson center, bright gold rim, and a long pale-gold cord.
object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the genuine Amulet of Yendor as the unique mithril quest artifact.
object:Amulet of Yendor / Amulet of Yend.modelBrief: Make an ornate yet compact gold-toned frame with a dark ruby-red center and bright rim; it should read close to, but finer than, the imitation.

object:large box.visualDescription: A squat reddish wooden box has a flat golden lid, dark side planks, and a small metal front lock.
object:large box.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the large box as a lockable wooden container, smaller and simpler than a chest.
object:large box.modelBrief: Build a low rectangular wood box with bright hinged lid and centered gray lock plate.

object:chest.visualDescription: A taller dark wood chest has a curved gold-trimmed lid, black interior seam, and orange front lock.
object:chest.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the chest as a lockable wooden container related to the large box.
object:chest.modelBrief: Make a tall heavy chest with arched slatted lid, deep dark opening line, and conspicuous central latch.

object:ice box.visualDescription: A rectangular blue ice box has a bright cyan lid, pale front lip, dark hinge side, and deep blue base.
object:ice box.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ice box as a plastic container for preserving food.
object:ice box.modelBrief: Build a hard-sided blue cooler with pale cyan hinged top and dark side hardware.

object:bag / sack.visualDescription: A tan drawstring sack has a narrow tied mouth, rounded body, darker seams, and flat base.
object:bag / sack.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the sack as an ordinary cloth container appearing as a bag.
object:bag / sack.modelBrief: Make one simple lumpy beige cloth bag with a dark tied neck; this appearance is shared by the nearby bag variants.

object:bag / oilskin sack.visualDescription: The tile repeats the tan tied sack, with rounded body and dark brown mouth.
object:bag / oilskin sack.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the oilskin sack as a cloth container that protects contents from water and appears as a bag.
object:bag / oilskin sack.modelBrief: Reuse the plain tan bag shape; any waterproof coating should be subtle and must not change the catalog appearance.

object:bag / bag of holding.visualDescription: The same pale tan drawstring bag sits upright with a small tied neck and broad lower body.
object:bag / bag of holding.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the bag of holding as a magical cloth container with unusual storage capacity.
object:bag / bag of holding.modelBrief: Reuse the ordinary bag appearance without depicting an oversized interior or magical glow.

object:bag / bag of tricks.visualDescription: A tan tied cloth bag has the same simple rounded silhouette as the other bag tiles.
object:bag / bag of tricks.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bag of tricks as a magical cloth bag that can produce monsters when applied.
object:bag / bag of tricks.modelBrief: Reuse the plain sack model; keep the trick effect separate from the visible bag.

object:key / skeleton key.visualDescription: A gold skeleton key lies diagonally, with a round bow, narrow shaft, and two dark teeth.
object:key / skeleton key.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the skeleton key as an iron unlocking tool appearing simply as a key.
object:key / skeleton key.modelBrief: Model a small old-fashioned key with circular head and notched bit, using the tile's warm gold color.

object:lock pick.visualDescription: A thin dark-gray lock pick lies diagonally and bends into a tiny hook at one end.
object:lock pick.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the lock pick as an iron tool for opening locks.
object:lock pick.modelBrief: Make a narrow steel pick with straight grip and sharply bent working tip.

object:credit card.visualDescription: A small black credit card has a gold corner square and two pale rows of markings.
object:credit card.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the credit card as a plastic lock-opening tool.
object:credit card.modelBrief: Build a thin black rectangle with gold chip-like patch and minimal pale printed stripes.

object:candle / tallow candle.visualDescription: An unlit white candle is a short diagonal waxy rod with pale cream edge and dark lower outline.
object:candle / tallow candle.wikiDescription: The wiki distinguishes tallow candle from wax candle by material, value, and shorter burning time; both are light sources.
object:candle / tallow candle.modelBrief: Make a small plain unlit ivory candle with no holder or flame, matching the paired candle tile.

object:candle / wax candle.visualDescription: The same small unlit white candle lies diagonally with cream highlight and dark edge.
object:candle / wax candle.wikiDescription: The wiki distinguishes wax candle from tallow candle by material, value, and longer burning time.
object:candle / wax candle.modelBrief: Reuse the plain unlit ivory candle model; material identity can differ without a visible shape change.

object:brass lantern.visualDescription: A copper-brown lantern has a top handle, glass chamber with pale flame, and broad vented base.
object:brass lantern.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the brass lantern as a refillable or chargeable copper light source.
object:brass lantern.modelBrief: Build a squat handled lantern with warm metal frame and pale lit chamber.

object:lamp / oil lamp.visualDescription: A golden oil lamp has a low foot, central spout, broad bowl, and curling handle.
object:lamp / oil lamp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the oil lamp as a copper light source that appears as a lamp before identification.
object:lamp / oil lamp.modelBrief: Model a gold-colored traditional lamp with long spout and curled handle, matching the shared lamp silhouette.

object:lamp / magic lamp.visualDescription: The tile repeats the gold lamp with a long left spout, raised center, and curled right handle.
object:lamp / magic lamp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic lamp as a magical copper lamp whose unidentified appearance is the same plain lamp.
object:lamp / magic lamp.modelBrief: Reuse the ordinary gold lamp model; keep magical function or genie effects separate.

object:expensive camera.visualDescription: A boxy brown camera has a black central lens, pale flash area, and a tall rectangular upper attachment.
object:expensive camera.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the expensive camera as a plastic tool whose flash can blind creatures.
object:expensive camera.modelBrief: Make a small vintage box camera with black lens circle and raised flash housing.

object:looking glass / mirror.visualDescription: A handheld looking glass has a warm gold oval frame, pale reflective face, and long brown handle.
object:looking glass / mirror.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the mirror as a glass tool appearing as a looking glass before identification.
object:looking glass / mirror.modelBrief: Build a handheld oval mirror with slim wood handle and broad cool reflective surface.

object:glass orb / crystal ball.visualDescription: A glass orb rests on a brown stepped stand, with a bright cream glint and deep blue-gray shadow.
object:glass orb / crystal ball.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the crystal ball as a glass divination tool that appears as a glass orb.
object:glass orb / crystal ball.modelBrief: Make a polished spherical glass ball in a small dark wooden cradle, with a restrained large highlight.

object:lenses.visualDescription: A pair of pale gold spectacles has two square lenses, a thin bridge, and reddish temple arms.
object:lenses.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies lenses as wearable glass eyewear.
object:lenses.modelBrief: Build a small pair of square framed eyeglasses with clear lenses and brown side arms.

object:blindfold.visualDescription: A dark maroon blindfold is folded into a long cloth band with loose ends.
object:blindfold.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the blindfold as a cloth tool used to cover the wearer's eyes.
object:blindfold.modelBrief: Make a soft burgundy cloth eye band with tied ends and dark folds.

object:towel.visualDescription: A pale cream towel lies as a folded rectangular cloth with white highlights and soft uneven edges.
object:towel.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the towel as a cloth tool that can wipe the face or be worn over the eyes.
object:towel.modelBrief: Model a folded off-white towel with a few thick fabric folds and no printed logo.

object:saddle.visualDescription: A brown leather saddle has a raised front and rear, curved seat, and hanging stirrup or straps.
object:saddle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the saddle as leather tack used to ride a suitable monster.
object:saddle.modelBrief: Build a small horse-style saddle with high pommel and cantle, dark leather seat, and visible hanging strap.

object:leash.visualDescription: A reddish-brown leash lies in a loose S coil with a darker grip and gray metal clip.
object:leash.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the leash as a leather tool used to tether a pet.
object:leash.modelBrief: Make a long flexible leather strap coiled on the ground, ending in a small metal clasp.

object:stethoscope.visualDescription: A stethoscope has pale gray earpieces, flexible brown tubing, and a darker chest piece.
object:stethoscope.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the stethoscope as a tool for inspecting the status of monsters and the hero.
object:stethoscope.modelBrief: Model a U-shaped listening tool with gray metal ends and russet flexible tube.

object:tinning kit.visualDescription: Three blue-gray cylindrical tins with pale lids overlap as a compact kit.
object:tinning kit.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tinning kit as an iron chargeable tool for preserving corpses in tins.
object:tinning kit.modelBrief: Build a small cluster of gray metal canisters with bright rims, keeping the kit portable.

object:tin opener.visualDescription: A brown wooden handle supports a short gray metal opener with a bent cutting tip.
object:tin opener.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tin opener as an iron tool that opens food tins quickly.
object:tin opener.modelBrief: Model a simple hand tool with warm wood grip and hooked steel cutting head.

object:can of grease.visualDescription: A small upright grease can has an olive lid, tan label, dark gray sides, and pale vertical mark.
object:can of grease.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the can of grease as a chargeable tool used to grease equipment.
object:can of grease.modelBrief: Build a squat metal cylinder with brown cap and plain cream label; keep grease inside the container.

object:figurine.visualDescription: A tiny rust-orange humanoid figurine stands on a flat brown pedestal with arms spread.
object:figurine.wikiDescription: The wiki describes figurines as magic miniature statues of monsters that can become living monsters.
object:figurine.modelBrief: Make this crop's simple small humanoid statuette on a base; allow the depicted monster form to vary elsewhere.

object:magic marker.visualDescription: A slim diagonal marker shows bands of cyan, yellow, orange, and red, ending in a dark nib.
object:magic marker.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic marker as a charged tool for writing magical scrolls and spellbooks.
object:magic marker.modelBrief: Build a narrow pen with brightly segmented barrel and dark writing tip, preserving its diagonal visual read.

object:land mine.visualDescription: A low brass-brown land mine is a flattened circular disc with raised central pressure plate.
object:land mine.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a land mine as a portable explosive trap that can be set on the ground.
object:land mine.modelBrief: Make a squat round metal mine with dark sides and a pale central trigger, without an active explosion.

object:beartrap.visualDescription: A gray steel beartrap has open serrated jaws and a vertical spring or lever on one side.
object:beartrap.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the beartrap as an iron tool commonly seen as a primed ground trap.
object:beartrap.modelBrief: Model an open hinged jaw trap with heavy teeth, base plate, and side mechanism.

object:whistle / tin whistle.visualDescription: A small pale silver whistle lies horizontally with a dark mouthpiece and open end.
object:whistle / tin whistle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tin whistle as a non-magical metal instrument that makes a loud sound.
object:whistle / tin whistle.modelBrief: Make a short smooth gray whistle with mouth slot and hollow end, using the shared whistle shape.

object:whistle / magic whistle.visualDescription: The same short silver whistle has a pale body and dark mouth opening.
object:whistle / magic whistle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic whistle as a metal instrument that summons a pet to the user's location.
object:whistle / magic whistle.modelBrief: Reuse the plain gray whistle form; keep the teleporting or summoning effect separate.

object:flute / wooden flute.visualDescription: A long narrow wooden flute lies diagonally, brown with dark finger-hole marks.
object:flute / wooden flute.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the wooden flute as a non-magical tonal instrument made of wood.
object:flute / wooden flute.modelBrief: Model a slim reddish wooden tube with open tip and evenly spaced finger holes.

object:flute / magic flute.visualDescription: The tile repeats the long brown flute with a tapered tip and small dark finger holes.
object:flute / magic flute.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic flute as a magical wooden instrument that can put nearby monsters to sleep.
object:flute / magic flute.modelBrief: Reuse the visible wooden flute design; magical sleep belongs to the instrument's effect.

object:horn / tooled horn.visualDescription: A curved cream horn has a wide dark mouth, brown tip, and small dotted tooling marks along the side.
object:horn / tooled horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tooled horn as a non-magical bone instrument appearing simply as a horn.
object:horn / tooled horn.modelBrief: Make a short curved ivory-bone horn with carved dots and dark hollow bell.

object:horn / frost horn.visualDescription: A curved cream bone horn has a wide dark bell, dotted side tooling, and an upturned narrow tip.
object:horn / frost horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the frost horn as a magical bone horn whose use sends a blast of cold.
object:horn / frost horn.modelBrief: Reuse the shared ivory horn silhouette with dark hollow mouth; keep cold projection as an effect, not permanent ice.

object:horn / fire horn.visualDescription: The tile repeats the same cream curved horn with brown mouth and dotted side.
object:horn / fire horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the fire horn as the fire-affinity counterpart to the frost horn.
object:horn / fire horn.modelBrief: Reuse the ordinary horn geometry and palette; its fire blast belongs to gameplay or animation.

object:horn / horn of plenty.visualDescription: The same short ivory horn curves upward and shows a dark open bell and small carved dots.
object:horn / horn of plenty.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the horn of plenty as a magical bone horn that produces food or potions from charges.
object:horn / horn of plenty.modelBrief: Reuse the shared bone horn appearance without showing food stuffed inside.

object:harp / wooden harp.visualDescription: A small brown harp has a tall vertical post, curved neck, flat base, and several pale blue strings.
object:harp / wooden harp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the wooden harp as a non-magical wooden tonal instrument.
object:harp / wooden harp.modelBrief: Build a compact standing harp with dark reddish frame and thin pale strings.

object:harp / magic harp.visualDescription: The tile repeats the brown standing harp with curved arm and light strings.
object:harp / magic harp.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic harp as a magical wooden instrument capable of taming nearby monsters.
object:harp / magic harp.modelBrief: Reuse the plain harp model; keep its taming effect separate from the wood and strings.

object:bell.visualDescription: A small gold handbell stands upright with a slim handle, flared body, and burgundy shadow on one side.
object:bell.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bell as a copper atonal instrument distinct from the special Bell of Opening.
object:bell.modelBrief: Make a simple polished gold-colored handbell with slender grip and flared bell body.

object:bugle.visualDescription: A brass bugle points right with a wide yellow bell, long straight tubing, and dark red looped lower pipe.
object:bugle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bugle as a copper tonal instrument without a magical counterpart.
object:bugle.modelBrief: Build a compact valveless brass bugle with looped tube and large flared bell.

object:drum / leather drum.visualDescription: A round brown leather drum has a pale taut top, woodlike vertical sides, and darker bottom rim.
object:drum / leather drum.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the leather drum as a non-magical atonal instrument.
object:drum / leather drum.modelBrief: Make a squat cylindrical hand drum with cream skin head and reddish-brown body.

object:drum / drum of earthquake.visualDescription: The tile repeats the same brown drum with pale head and dark lower rim.
object:drum / drum of earthquake.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the drum of earthquake as a magical leather drum that can cause an earthquake when charged.
object:drum / drum of earthquake.modelBrief: Reuse the plain drum appearance; ground cracking should occur only as an effect.

object:pick-axe.visualDescription: A steel pick-axe has a pointed double-ended head, short wooden socket, and long diagonal brown handle.
object:pick-axe.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the pick-axe as an iron digging tool that can also serve as a weapon.
object:pick-axe.modelBrief: Build a long wood haft with a dark steel curved pick on one side and shorter blunt edge on the other.

object:grappling hook.visualDescription: A gray multi-pronged grappling hook is attached to a tan-brown rope coil near its base.
object:grappling hook.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the grappling hook as an iron hook tool used to snag or pull things at range.
object:grappling hook.modelBrief: Model a heavy three- or four-pronged steel hook with attached coil of brown rope.

object:unicorn horn.visualDescription: A long tapered unicorn horn lies diagonally, brown at its broad base and pale cream toward its sharp tip.
object:unicorn horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the unicorn horn as a bone tool and weapon used to cure several harmful conditions.
object:unicorn horn.modelBrief: Sculpt a single spiraled tapering horn with tan base and ivory tip; keep healing effects separate.

object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a gold seven-branched candelabrum with a wide foot and unlit cup-like tips. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.wikiDescription: The Candelabrum of Invocation is a unique ritual item used in the Invocation. The source label names the artifact; the tile gives its gold multi-arm appearance.
object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.modelBrief: Build a stable gold pedestal rising into seven candle cups, keeping each branch separated and unlit. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a tall silver bell with a loop handle, narrow neck, and broad dark-rimmed mouth. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.wikiDescription: The Bell of Opening is a unique Invocation item. Its silver-bell appearance is visible here; the ritual role does not add visible glow.
object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.modelBrief: Build a small polished silver handbell with an oval loop, flared mouth, and dark opening. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:tripe ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a heap of glossy dark reddish-brown folded meat with orange highlights. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:tripe ration.wikiDescription: A tripe ration is a fleshy edible item in NetHack. The wiki does not prescribe this heap shape or color.
object:tripe ration.modelBrief: Build an irregular folded heap of dark red tripe with broad wet-looking lobes and restrained highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:corpse.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark brown lump of meat with a red cut face, a pale protruding bone, and a small tail-like end. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:corpse.wikiDescription: A corpse is the body of a dead monster and can vary by species. This generic tile should not imply a fixed creature anatomy.
object:corpse.modelBrief: Build a compact generic carcass chunk with one pale bone protrusion and red exposed section, without species-specific limbs. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:egg.visualDescription: PixelHack shows one upright ivory egg with tan lower shading and a bright white highlight. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:egg.wikiDescription: An egg is an edible item that may hatch into a monster if left uneaten. The pictured shell gives no species clue.
object:egg.modelBrief: Build a single oval cream shell with a broad pale glint and tan shadow near its base. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:meatball.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a small red-brown round meatball with yellow-orange speckles. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meatball.wikiDescription: A meatball is a fleshy comestible in NetHack. Its size and cooked-looking color are PixelHack choices.
object:meatball.modelBrief: Build one compact round red-brown meatball with a few warm uneven surface highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:meat stick.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thin red-brown meat stick bent slightly upward at one end. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meat stick.wikiDescription: A meat stick is a fleshy comestible in NetHack, distinct from the spherical meatball.
object:meat stick.modelBrief: Build a narrow irregular sausage-like stick of meat with dark ends and a low curved silhouette. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:enormous meatball.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a very large red mound with orange flecks, broad flat base, and uneven top. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:enormous meatball.wikiDescription: The enormous meatball is an oversized fleshy food item. The tile emphasizes size relative to the ordinary meatball.
object:enormous meatball.modelBrief: Build an oversized irregular rounded mass of red meat with broad footprint and scattered warm flecks. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Huge chunk of meat

object:meat ring.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark red closed ring of meat with a clear central opening and brighter upper rim. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meat ring.wikiDescription: A meat ring is a fleshy comestible. The edible ring identity supports the hole, while the exact red treatment comes from the tile.
object:meat ring.modelBrief: Build a thick torus of red meat with a visible open center and subtle warm highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of gray ooze.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low gray-brown amorphous blob with a pale square highlight and dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of gray ooze.wikiDescription: Globs are edible remnants dropped by oozes and puddings; the gray-ooze glob is one of four types.
object:glob of gray ooze.modelBrief: Build a low soft gray ooze glob with an uneven rim and pale upper highlight, without a face. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of brown pudding.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low warm-brown amorphous glob with a pale gold highlight and dark foot. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of brown pudding.wikiDescription: The brown-pudding glob is one of four edible globs dropped instead of a corpse.
object:glob of brown pudding.modelBrief: Build a squat brown pudding glob with rounded asymmetry and warm yellow glint. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of green slime.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a vivid green mound with angular lime facets and a very dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of green slime.wikiDescription: The green-slime glob is an edible remnant of green slime, though eating it is dangerous.
object:glob of green slime.modelBrief: Build a small lumpy green slime mass with a bright lime face and no eyes or limbs. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of black pudding.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a nearly black low glob with slate-gray glints and a broad dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of black pudding.wikiDescription: The black-pudding glob is a fleshy edible drop from black pudding.
object:glob of black pudding.modelBrief: Build an irregular low black pudding mass with subtle cool gray reflective patches. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:gray / luckstone.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat gray-beige rounded stone with angular tan facets, a dark lower rim, and one pale highlight. Tiles 1261-1264 are pixel-identical. The teal floor pattern is background.
object:gray / luckstone.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the luckstone as a stone that can affect carried Luck. All four gray-stone identities have the same visible PixelHack artwork, so the model should not reveal the function.
object:gray / luckstone.modelBrief: Build one small rounded gray-beige stone with a few broad facets and a dark underside. Reuse the exact visible model for luckstone, loadstone, touchstone, and flint.

object:gray / loadstone.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat gray-beige rounded stone with angular tan facets, a dark lower rim, and one pale highlight. Tiles 1261-1264 are pixel-identical. The teal floor pattern is background.
object:gray / loadstone.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the loadstone as a stone that is a heavy stone that can burden its carrier. All four gray-stone identities have the same visible PixelHack artwork, so the model should not reveal the function.
object:gray / loadstone.modelBrief: Build one small rounded gray-beige stone with a few broad facets and a dark underside. Reuse the exact visible model for luckstone, loadstone, touchstone, and flint.

object:gray / touchstone.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat gray-beige rounded stone with angular tan facets, a dark lower rim, and one pale highlight. Tiles 1261-1264 are pixel-identical. The teal floor pattern is background.
object:gray / touchstone.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the touchstone as a stone that is used to test or identify gems. All four gray-stone identities have the same visible PixelHack artwork, so the model should not reveal the function.
object:gray / touchstone.modelBrief: Build one small rounded gray-beige stone with a few broad facets and a dark underside. Reuse the exact visible model for luckstone, loadstone, touchstone, and flint.

object:gray / flint.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a squat gray-beige rounded stone with angular tan facets, a dark lower rim, and one pale highlight. Tiles 1261-1264 are pixel-identical. The teal floor pattern is background.
object:gray / flint.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the flint as a stone that is an ordinary stone usable as ammunition. All four gray-stone identities have the same visible PixelHack artwork, so the model should not reveal the function.
object:gray / flint.modelBrief: Build one small rounded gray-beige stone with a few broad facets and a dark underside. Reuse the exact visible model for luckstone, loadstone, touchstone, and flint.

object:rock.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low cluster of two or three reddish-brown uneven stones with small ochre highlights and a black foot. The teal pattern is background.
object:rock.wikiDescription: The wiki describes a rock as a small stackable stone that can be thrown. This tile depicts a low cluster, but the item count is not determined by the art.
object:rock.modelBrief: Build a few irregular brown stone chunks sharing one low silhouette, with dark undersides. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:boulder.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a huge near-round rust-brown stone with orange speckling and a broad nearly black base. The teal pattern is background.
object:boulder.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a boulder as a huge stone object that occupies a dungeon square. PixelHack gives it a bulky rounded, warm-brown treatment.
object:boulder.modelBrief: Build one massive roughly spherical boulder with uneven rocky facets, orange flecks, and broad dark base. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:statue.visualDescription: PixelHack shows an upright pale gray stone figure with an indistinct head, raised side form, and rough pedestal. The teal pattern is background.
object:statue.wikiDescription: The wiki notes that a statue represents a monster and may use a grayscale monster tile. This generic object tile shows a small humanoid stone figure but does not dictate every monster-specific statue shape.
object:statue.modelBrief: Build a rough pale stone humanoid figure on a low block base for this fallback tile; use each monster's own silhouette when building its separate statue tile. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:heavy iron ball.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a nearly black blue-gray sphere with a dim slate center highlight and no visible chain. The teal pattern is background.
object:heavy iron ball.wikiDescription: A heavy iron ball is an iron item commonly associated with punishment. The chain is a separate object tile, and no link is visible here.
object:heavy iron ball.modelBrief: Build a plain dark iron sphere with small cool-gray highlight and substantial round mass; leave the chain separate. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:iron chain.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick nearly black chain forming an open bent loop, with several large squared links. The teal pattern is background.
object:iron chain.wikiDescription: An iron chain is a separate NetHack object that can connect to a heavy iron ball. The tile shows only linked chain, not the ball.
object:iron chain.modelBrief: Build a short freely curved chain of large dark iron links, leaving open gaps between the loops. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:splash of venom / splash of blind.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a suspended cluster of magenta and pink liquid droplets, with one large center splash and several smaller beads. The teal pattern is background.
object:splash of venom / splash of blind.wikiDescription: The wiki describes blinding venom as a liquid projectile that splashes over a target's face. Both venom types have a generic splash appearance, while the visible pink palette comes from PixelHack.
object:splash of venom / splash of blind.modelBrief: Build a frozen splash of pink-magenta fluid with one broad central lobe and separated small droplets; avoid a bottle or solid stone. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.

object:splash of venom / splash of acid.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a suspended cluster of olive-yellow liquid droplets, with a pale central splash and several smaller beads. The teal pattern is background.
object:splash of venom / splash of acid.wikiDescription: The wiki describes acid venom as a liquid projectile that deals acid damage. It shares a generic splash appearance with blinding venom; this tile uses a distinct yellow-green palette.
object:splash of venom / splash of acid.modelBrief: Build a frozen splash of yellow-olive acidic fluid with a broad central lobe and separate droplets; match the pink venom silhouette without merging palettes. Keep the silhouette legible at 32-pixel size.
